content.Title: Böllhoff als Arbeitgeber | Böllhoff
content.MainContent: Kommen Sie ins TeamBöllhoff als ArbeitgeberBöllhoff ist anders! Das glauben Sie nicht? Dann lassen Sie sich überzeugen – und bewerben Sie sich bei uns!Was wir Ihnen bietenWen wir suchenWas uns ausmachtFamiliär, menschlich und verantwortungsvollOb im Flugzeugtriebwerk, im Autochassis oder im Rasenmähroboter – Verbindungselemente von Böllhoff finden sich so gut wie überall. Rund um den Globus unterstützen wir unsere Kunden, Teile zu einem großen Ganzen zusammenzufügen – seit über 145 Jahren. Unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter bilden mit ihrer Begeisterung für erfolgreiche Verbindungen das Fundament unseres Erfolgs.Ob im Flugzeugtriebwerk, im Autochassis oder im Rasenmähroboter – Verbindungselemente von Böllhoff finden sich so gut wie überall. Rund um den Globus unterstützen wir unsere Kunden, Teile zu einem großen Ganzen zusammenzufügen – seit über 145 Jahren. Unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter bilden mit ihrer Begeisterung für erfolgreiche Verbindungen das Fundament unseres Erfolgs.Wir sind ein internationales FamilienunternehmenAls unabhängiges Familienunternehmen stehen wir seit vier Generationen und mehr als 145 Jahren für erfolgreiche Verbindungen. Diese Eigenständigkeit bleibt auch künftig der Schrittmacher zur Weiterentwicklung des Unternehmens. Diesen Weg möchten wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen fortsetzen.Wir kümmern uns um SieUnsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter sind der Garant für unseren heutigen und zukünftigen Erfolg. Deshalb geben wir ihnen die Chance, sich fachlich und persönlich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. In einer Arbeitsatmosphäre, die von Menschlichkeit und Wertschätzung geprägt ist.Wir übernehmen VerantwortungNachhaltig zu wirtschaften bedeutet für uns, auch für die Gesellschaft ein starker Partner zu sein und ihr etwas zurückzugeben – indem wir uns in sozialen Projekten engagieren und wir unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter darin unterstützen, ihren eigenen Beitrag zum Gemeinwohl zu leisten.Ihre Benefits bei BöllhoffGemeinsam ErfolgreichWir wissen, dass wir unseren Erfolg unseren Mitarbeitenden zu verdanken haben. Daher ist es uns wichtig, Wertschätzung zu zeigen und mehr als nur einen Arbeitsplatz zu bieten. Wir unterstützen Sie dabei, Ihre Ziele zu erreichen und Ihre Fähigkeiten voll zu entfalten. Zusätzlich fördern wir eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance und Sie profitieren bei uns von attraktiven Benefits.Work-Life-BalanceAls Familienunternehmen liegt uns die Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf besonders am Herzen.Work-Life-BalanceWir begrüßen es, wenn sich Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter im Rahmen einer Elternzeit oder einer Familienpflegezeit um ihre Angehörigen kümmern. Es freut uns, dass dieses Angebot mittlerweile verstärkt wahrgenommen wird. Konkret bieten wir Ihnen Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle Zeitkonten / Gleitzeit Home Office / Mobiles Arbeiten Kindergarten- und U3-Kitaplätze Ferienangebote für Kinder Familienpflegezeit / Elternzeit Sabbatical VergütungWir setzen auf eine faire, attraktive und leistungsorientierte Vergütung.VergütungUnsere Vergütungsregeln basieren auf tariflichen und betrieblichen Vereinbarungen. Eine faire marktgerechte Entlohnung ist für uns ebenso selbstverständlich wie die Einhaltung von Mindestlohnansprüchen. Faire Entlohnung heißt für uns auch, dass die Vergütung unabhängig von personengebundenen Faktoren wie Geschlecht, Konfession, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderungen oder sexueller Orientierung geschieht. Konkret bieten wir Ihnen Attraktive Vergütung Erfolgsbeteiligung Betriebliche Altersvorsorge 30 Urlaubstage Sonderurlaub bei Jubiläen GesundheitWir bieten unseren Beschäftigten zahlreiche Programme zum Erhalt und der Förderung ihrer Gesundheit.GesundheitMit unserem ISO-zertifizierten Managementsystem für Arbeitsschutz sorgen wir für Sicherheit und Gesundheit am Arbeitsplatz. Im Rahmen von „Böllhoff Fit“ machen wir allen Beschäftigten weitere Angebote, wie Betriebssport, Förderungen für Fitnessstudios oder regelmäßige Gesundheitstage, bspw. zu gesunder Ernährung sowie diversen Gesundheitschecks. Konkret bieten wir Ihnen Sichere Arbeitsbedingungen und ergonomische Arbeitsplätze Betriebliche Gesundheitsangebote Betriebssport und Firmenläufe Vergünstigter Beitrag in vielen Fitnessstudios Gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserem Mitarbeiterrestaurant WeiterbildungDie kontinuierliche Weiterbildung unserer Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter ist uns wichtig.WeiterbildungWir haben verschiedene Programme zur Entwicklung unserer Fach- und Führungskräfte – sowohl national als auch international. In unserem Böllhoff Förderprogramm unterstützen wir die persönliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter, indem ihnen systematisch Schlüsselqualifikationen aus den Bereichen Führungs-, Sozial- und Methodenkompetenz vermittelt werden. Das Förderprogramm ist fest in unseren Personalentwicklungsaktivitäten verankert. Konkret bieten wir Ihnen Breit gefächerte Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten Umfangreiche Seminarangebote Fach- und Führungskräfteentwicklung Soziale LeistungenUnsere Böllhoff Sozialordnung fixiert eine Vielzahl an freiwilligen Sozial- und Zusatzleistungen.Soziale LeistungenWir leisten mit einer jährlichen Erfolgsbeteiligung einen Beitrag zur Altersvorsorge unserer Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter, ehren sie zu sozialen Anlässen und Jubiläen mit Sach- oder Geldgeschenken und organisieren regelmäßig Betriebsausflüge. Zudem erhalten sie Ermäßigungen in zahlreichen Restaurants und Geschäften sowie bei kulturellen und sportlichen Veranstaltungen. Konkret bieten wir Ihnen Sach- und Geldgeschenke bei sozialen Anlässen und Jubiläen Familienausflüge und -feste Mitarbeiterevents Unterstützung des sozialen Engagements unserer Beschäftigten Kostenlose Parkplätze Wen wir suchenWir suchen offene, neugierige und bodenständige Menschen, die mit beiden Beinen im Leben stehen und mit uns die Zukunft der Verbindungstechnik gestalten möchten. Wir sind und bleiben ein Familienunternehmen – und sprechen uns alle über alle Hierarchie-Ebenen mit Vornamen an. Bei uns finden Sie flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege und sehr viel individuellen Gestaltungsspielraum. BerufserfahreneErfahrung und Expertise machen uns besser – deshalb sind Berufserfahre bei uns herzlich willkommen.BerufseinsteigerWir freuen uns über neue Gesichter und frischen Wind und kümmern uns individuell um Berufsanfänger!Ausbildung und StudiumAls Familienunternehmen legen wir großen Wert auf unseren Nachwuchs! InitiativbewerbungSie sind der Meinung, Sie passen unheimlich gut zu uns? Ja dann, nichts wie los – bewerben Sie sich!„Böllhoff steht für Erfolg. Wir sind ein Familienunternehmen, arbeiten verantwortungsvoll und wollen mit unseren Produkten und den Menschen in unserem Unternehmen begeistern.“Frank NientiedtLeiter Bildungscampus Böllhoff und Employer Branding»OnboardingWir möchten, dass Sie gut bei uns ankommen!Für einen guten Start bei Böllhoff setzen wir auf ein individuelles Einarbeitungsprogramm, das jeder Mitarbeiter und jede Mitarbeiterin ab dem ersten Arbeitstag bei uns verfolgt. Wir beginnen mit einem Willkommenspaket und einer ersten allgemeinen Einweisung in unser Unternehmen. Danach stehen arbeitsplatzbezogene, fachspezifische Themen, genauso wie unternehmensübergreifende Themen auf dem Plan.Lernen Sie unsere Kultur, unser Miteinander und alles, was uns als Unternehmen aus- und stark macht in unserem „Böllhoff Way“ kennen! Denn wir möchten, dass Sie gut bei uns ankommen – und unsere „Begeisterung für erfolgreiche Verbindungen“ teilen! content.Title: Shop Manager Brugge - 36u/week - contract onbepaalde duur - Etam
content.MainContent: Shops Etam Belgium · Bruges Steenstraat 0728 Shop Manager Brugge - 36u/week - contract onbepaalde duur Solliciteren We reageren meestal binnen een week Je rapporteert aan een regionale directeur en bent verantwoordelijk voor de naleving van het verkoopbeleid en treedt op als ambassadeur van ons merk en onze waarden.Je belangrijkste taken zijn- De verkoop stimuleren door een onberispelijke klantenservice en winkelimago te handhaven.- De prestaties van de winkel ontwikkelen door de verschillende indicatoren op te volgen (omzet, gemiddeld winkelmandje, conversiepercentage, enz.).- Je team beheren en leiden in overeenstemming met de waarden van het bedrijf: talent aanwerven, integreren, opleiden en ontwikkelen door middel van een sterke teamgeest.- Ervoor zorgen dat het verkooppunt soepel verloopt, dat de procedures worden nageleefd en dat de waarden van het bedrijf worden uitgedragen.- De HR-administratie en logistiek van de winkel beheren door toezicht te houden op het personeelsbeheer (tijdregistratie, planning, afwezigheden, enz.) en het voorraadbeheer, terwijl je de aanbevelingen van de winkel op het gebied van merchandising en etalage aanpast.Je wilt graag aan de slag bij een toonaangevende Europese lingeriegroep en werken in een creatieve en innovatieve omgeving.Je hebt succesvolle leidinggevende ervaring in de detailhandel, maar vooral je verlangen om te leren en te groeien binnen onze groep is essentieel.Je bent een dynamische teamspeler en geniet ervan om je collega's dagelijks te ondersteunen.Je bent proactief en toegewijd, je bent streng en hebt een constante zorg voor klantenservice.Je hebt een sterk commercieel temperament en maakt je winkel graag gastvrij.Als je graag uitgedaagd wordt en er alles aan doet om je doelen te bereiken, dan is dit de baan voor jou!Het team wacht alleen nog op jou!Een groep, kansenEen dynamische werkomgeving met echte doorgroeimogelijkheden. De integratie wordt vanaf dag één doordacht en interne mobiliteit wordt op alle niveaus aangemoedigd: in 2025 werd 55% van de managementfuncties in de winkels intern ingevuld.Zich ontwikkelen en opleidenEen interne opleidingsschool ondersteunt medewerkers met concrete trajecten om door te groeien. Opleidingen en een e-learningplatform met meer dan 200 modules stellen iedereen in staat zich verder te ontwikkelen. In 2025 werd 84% van de medewerkers opgeleid.Dagelijkse voordelenKortingen op de collectiesAantrekkelijke variabele verloningInnovatieve digitale klantentools (clienteling)Concrete engagementenSinds eind 2025 B Corp™-gecertificeerd, bevestigt de Etam Groep haar engagement voor meer verantwoorde mode. Deze certificering, die aantoont dat wij voldoen aan gecontroleerde normen op het vlak van sociale en milieuprocedures, transparantie en verantwoordelijkheid, ligt in het verlengde van de transitie die in 2019 werd gestart via ons WeCare-verantwoordelijkheidsprogramma. content.Title: Launch Project Quality Engineer - Autoliv Poland
content.MainContent: Launch Project Quality Engineer To stanowisko nie jest już aktywne Stanowisko zostało obsadzone lub ogłoszenie wygasło. Autoliv Poland Jelcz-Laskowice (APA) Środowisko pracy, kultura organizacyjna U nas liczy się współpraca, zaufanie i szacunek. Tworzymy środowisko, w którym każdy może się rozwijać, dzielić wiedzą i czuć, że jego praca ma znaczenie. Chcemy, żeby każdy miał poczucie bezpieczeństwa, wsparcia i przestrzeń do rozwoju. Wierzymy w odpowiedzialne działanie i w to, że dobre relacje są fundamentem wszystkiego, co robimy. Informacje o firmie Autoliv Poland Jesteśmy w Polsce już od 27 lat!Autoliv powstało w 1957 roku w Szwecji. Od tego czasu nieustannie mamy jedną wspólną misję: Saving More Lives, czyli: ocalić jak najwięcej żyć. Wierzymy, że jedną z podstawowych wolności człowieka jest wolność do przemieszczania się i podróżowania. Jednocześnie wiemy, że taka wolność może w pełni rozkwitać wyłącznie w warunkach całkowitego bezpieczeństwa. Niezależnie, czy to nasz pracownik, klient, partner biznesowy czy dostawca, człowiek zawsze stał w centralnym punkcie naszego pojmowania biznesu. Twoje bezpieczeństwo jest dla nas absolutnym priorytetem.W naszych polskich zakładach w Jelczu-Laskowicach i Oławie produkujemy części tekstylne poduszek powietrznych. Dodatkowo w Jelczu projektujemy i wykonujemy moduły poduszek powietrznych, zaś w Oławie projektujemy ich części tekstylne. Rok założenia Polska 1998 Współpracownicy około 3,500

content.Title: Servicetekniker/Handyman - Awaze
content.MainContent: Operations · Søndervig · Hybrid Servicetekniker/Handyman Apply for this job Vil du bruge dine tekniske evner til at sikre, at ferier starter problemfrit og slutter med glade gæster og tilfredse ejere?Som Servicetekniker i Søndervig bliver du en nøglespiller i vores daglige drift. Du sørger for, at ferieboligerne fungerer, som de skal – og at alt fra spa til varmepumper og WiFi virker fra første dag. Her er ingen dage ens, og din indsats har direkte betydning for både gæsteoplevelsen og vores serviceniveau.Din missionMed reference til din Servicetekniske leder bliver din mission at levere vedligeholdelse og teknisk service i høj kvalitet – hver eneste gang. Du sikrer, at opgaver bliver løst korrekt og effektivt, og du er med til at opretholde en ensartet driftsstandard i alle vores ferieboliger. Din rolle er både praktisk og problemløsende, og du bliver en vigtig del af et driftsteam, der samarbejder tæt på tværs af funktioner og lokationer.Dine opgaverUdføre teknisk service og vedligehold på ferieboliger – sikkert, kvalitetsbevidst og omkostningseffektivtBetjene og vedligeholde tekniske faciliteter som pools, spa, varmepumper, TV, internet m.m.Diagnosticere fejl og koordinere reparationer – eller eskalere til Technician Lead ved behovDokumentere fejl, løsninger og opgaver korrekt – især ved fakturering til ejereFølge instruktioner fra Planner og Technician Lead ved opgavefordelingGennemføre inspektioner og sikre opfølgning og dokumentationBidrage til at optimere arbejdstid – f.eks. ved at kombinere opgaver (eks. pooltjek + teknisk service)Følge lager- og materialestyringsprocesser for udstyr og reservedeleArbejde i tråd med fastlagte arbejdsgange og retningslinjerProfilen vi søgerDu vil trives i rollen, hvis du har teknisk flair, elsker at finde løsninger og sætter en ære i at levere godt håndværk. Du går til opgaverne med struktur og ansvarsfølelse og har fokus på kvalitet og effektivitet – også når det går stærkt.Vi leder efter en kollega, der kan byde ind med:Erfaring med teknisk service, bygningsvedligehold eller lignende driftsfunktionerKommerciel forståelse og tryghed ved at arbejde efter budget og effektiviseringsmålTekniske kompetencer inden for f.eks. pool/spa, VVS, el, HVAC eller lignendeEn praktisk, struktureret og løsningsorienteret tilgangSikkerhedsbevidsthed og fokus på at forbedre processer, produktivitet og kundeoplevelsenDet er en bonus, hvis du har erfaring med data- eller procesdrevne forbedringerSådan får du succesRepræsentere Awaze’s værdier og sikre høj kvalitet i alt arbejdeDiagnosticere, løse og – om nødvendigt – eskalere tekniske opgaver korrektLøse opgaver rigtigt første gang og sikre høj tilfredshed hos gæster og ejereArbejde tæt sammen med Planner-teamet og følge deres opgavefordelingOverholde processer for lagerstyring og vedligeholdLevere opgaver til tiden og inden for budgetBidrage til løbende forbedringer og sikre opfølgning på initiativerUnderstøtte en kultur med ansvarlighed, effektivitet og service excellenceDerfor vil du gerne arbejde hos AwazeVi tilbyder en alsidig stilling i et stærkt fagligt og socialt miljø, som du selv får indflydelse på at udvikle og præge. Du bliver del af en international virksomhed, som investerer i fremtiden, samt en spændende og dynamisk hverdag og afdeling med dygtige og engagerede kolleger, som hjælper hinanden. Derudover tilbyder vi pensionsordning inklusiv sundhedsforsikring, 5 ugers ferie og 5 feriefridage efter 9 måneders ansættelse, gode rabatter på leje af feriehuse i Europa til dig, din familie og venner samt en række andre personalegoder.Om AwazeHos Awaze gør vi ferier levende. Med over 110.000 ferieboliger i 25 lande er vi Europas største udbyder af ferieboliger. Vores formål er enkelt – at begejstre vores gæster og ejere og samtidig skabe en inspirerende arbejdsplads for vores medarbejdere.Awaze A/S er en del af Europas førende udbyder af ferieboliger og driver mere end 25 historiske brands, herunder Cottages.com, NOVASOL og Hoseasons.Du bliver ansat af Awaze A/S og kommer til at arbejde med NOVASOL-brandet, som har det største udvalg af ferieboliger i Danmark og over 50.000 på tværs af Europa.Værd at videDer er tale om en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer, hvor du skal være indstillet på at arbejde mindst hver anden weekend en stor del af året. En væsentlig del af jobbet indebærer kørsel i området, hvorfor gyldigt kørekort kræves.Du bliver ansat i Awaze A/S og kommer til at arbejde med NOVASOL-brandet, som har det største udvalg af ferieboliger i Danmark og over 50.000 ferieboliger på tværs af Europa.Hvad er næste skridt?Hvis dette lyder som det rette næste skridt for dig, så klik på “Ansøg” og følg instruktionerne for at indsende din ansøgning. Vi tilpasser vores rekrutteringsproces til hver enkelt rolle for at give både dig og vores ansættende team de bedste forudsætninger for at vurdere, om dette kan blive starten på et godt samarbejde. Du hører fra os, så snart vi har gennemgået din ansøgning.Vi er dedikerede til at sikre en inkluderende og tilgængelig rekrutteringsproces. Alle ansøgninger bliver behandlet ligeværdigt. Har du særlige behov eller ønsker i forbindelse med interviewet, er du meget velkommen til at informere os, når du takker ja til invitationen – vi gør gerne de nødvendige tilpasninger. Department Operations Role Maintenance Technician Locations Søndervig Remote status Hybrid Our Perks & Benefits 🌴 Travel that inspires All of our team members get exclusive travel discounts on over 100,000 properties across Europe - relax, recharge, and experience our product like a guest, gaining valuable insight along the way. 🏆 Join a market leader We are proud to be the leading managed vacation rental player in Europe. We operate well known brands with a strong heritage in over 25 countries and have more than 100,000 holiday accommodation choices. 🌍 Other local benefits Our benefits are adapted to each country we operate in, ensuring competitive, locally relevant support and perks wherever you're based. What to expect from our hiring process At Awaze, we know that applying for a new role is a big step - so we aim to make our hiring process as clear, respectful, and engaging as possible.We believe hiring should be a two-way conversation. It’s just as much about you getting to know us, as it is about us learning more about you.While the exact process can vary depending on the role, here’s what you can generally expect: 1. Initial Conversation We like to keep things relaxed, so we'll usually start with an informal call. This is a chance for us to get to know each other, learn about your background and interests, and give you a better sense of the role and Awaze as a whole. 2. Interview Stage If our initial conversation goes well, we will invite you for an interview. This stage will give us an opportunity to understand your skills and potential, and for you to explore whether Awaze, the culture and the role align with your ambitions. 3. Additional Steps Some roles may involve follow-up interviews, presentations or skills assessments. If that's the case, our team will talk you through every step, so you always know what to expect. We are committed to continue expanding our presence in Colombia and South America to potentialize the work we do with our clients and influence the evolution of our region. For this, we are looking for top talent! I invite you to explore more about BCG, our values, our work, our people and if you are interested after this, I invite you to prepare yourself and apply. You will not regret it." Juliana Sguerra Managing Director and Partner BCG Colombia A motivational environment. Working at BCG you will not only feel motivated and challenged by the problems client's trust us to solve, but you will work with extremely talented, well-rounded, down to earth, nice and fun individuals that will make your journey at BCG an incredible one. Application requirements for our consulting positions Each application should meet our minimum academic requirements: Excellent academic results The final year of Bachelor's or completed Bachelor's, Master's, MBA, or Ph.D. degree for full-time positions. Ongoing Bachelor's (final year) or first year Master's in case of Internship positions. In addition to academic records, we are looking for extensive extra-curricular activities to demonstrate evidence of impact and legacy, significant contribution, high level of commitment, initiative, and responsibility. We seek to hire passionate, open-minded individuals from a variety of academic backgrounds, work experiences, perspectives, thinking styles, and expertise. Many talented professionals without business backgrounds come to BCG and thrive here: physicists, historians, chemists, and lawyers have all become successful consultants at BCG. Our application process Step 1 Online Application Each application should include your CV and a Cover Letter. We want to get to know you so please make sure you include information in your cover letter and CV about things you’re passionate about and why BCG is a great career fit for you. Step 2 Online Case If we decide to take your application further, we'll invite you to complete an Online Case Experience. This will test your quantitative skills, data interpretations, calculations, and business logic. You will have 30 minutes to complete the test and at the end, you must record a 1-minute video with the final recommendation. Step 3 Interview Rounds If you pass the Online Case Experience, we'll invite you to a first round of interviews. This round will consist of two/three case interviews that will last 45 minutes each. We'll provide you with detailed feedback and, depending on how you perform, we may invite you to a final round of interviews. The final round will consist of two/three case interviews that will last 45 minutes each as well. Step 4 Offer If you succeed in your interview process, you will receive an offer and be invited to be part of BCG. We truly believe that BCG will provide you with the best platform for you to continue building a successful career, surrounded by highly talented individuals and in a collaborative environment. A sense of mutual respect and mindfulness permeates our culture-in fact, it’s the key to our success. Learn more Learn more about our consulting roles Visiting Associates As a Visiting Associate you will have the opportunity to join us, becoming fully involved in transformational, cutting-edge client work together with your team. The knowledge, experience, and skills you gain will provide you with a springboard to excel in any field within BCG and beyond. After a successfully completed internship, you may be offered to return to BCG as a Full-time Associate upon the completion of your university studies. Apply here Associates Entry-level, from the last year of University up to 3 years of work experience. Joining BCG means taking an important step in making a real impact in the world. All the ideas you've formed at university, all the life experiences you've had will come to play. The learning curve can be steep at times. But with determination, a willingness to learn, and empowering support from mentors you'll be in the best place, surrounded by the best people, to achieve your full potential. apply here Consultants Applications are open all year round for experienced professionals or those who are in the first year for Summer (Internship) position or completing/have recently completed an MBA. As I continue my career at BCG, I look forward to future opportunities to re-invent and challenge myself." Christopher Weisz Partner, BCGX "I'm passionate about Social Impact. Last year, we launched The Work Preparation Program, a BCG volunteer regional program to support the post-prison population in Colombia with their CV and job interviews. This initiative allowed BCGers to coach and mentor approximately 80 young Colombian ex-convicts through one-on-one sessions." content.MainContent: Associate, BlackRock Investment Stewardship - Financials Sector Location: New York, New York Team: Corporate Governance Job Requisition #: R265463 Date posted: Jul. 23, 2026 Apply Save job Job description About this roleFunction DescriptionThe BlackRock Investment Stewardship team (BIS) operates across three regions – the Americas (New York, Washington DC, Wilmington and San Francisco); Europe, Middle East and Africa (London); and Asia-Pacific (Tokyo, Hong Kong, Singapore and Sydney) – and undertakes engagement with and proxy voting at portfolio companies on behalf of index clients globally.As a team of high performing specialists globally, BIS is proud of our global reach and local presence.Team OverviewInvestment stewardship is one way BlackRock fulfills our fiduciary responsibilities as an asset manager to our clients. BlackRock Investment Stewardship serves as a link between our clients and the companies they invest in. We take a long-term approach to stewardship, focused on engaging with company boards and executive leadership to understand the drivers of risk and financial value creation in companies’ business models. Our sole focus when we engage with companies or vote at shareholder meetings is to advance our clients’ financial interests. As part of our fiduciary duty to our clients, we consider it one of our responsibilities to promote sound corporate governance as an informed, engaged shareholder on their behalf.Role OverviewThe BIS Investment Stewardship Professional will assist the lead analyst covering companies in Financial Services and/or Real Estate (REITs) sectors. They will provide support on portfolio company analysis, engagement, and voting. The intention is for the person in this role to ultimately specialize in a subset of the companies in the given sector, along with various aspects of relevant policy, to support the delivery of our annual and long-term objectives. They will work alongside the lead sector analyst for that industry and report to the Deputy Head of the Stewardship team in the Americas.Key responsibilities:Demonstrate sector expertise across financial services (banking, insurance, capital markets, consumer finance, diversified financials) and real estate (REITs), including pertaining to corporate governance, material market trends, regulatory developments, and sustainability practicesLearn and apply BIS engagement priorities and proxy voting guidelines in order to apply consistent judgment in engagement and votingPartner with lead sector analyst(s) to execute engagement and voting responsibilities to further the long-term financial interests of our clientsPrepare for, assist (and in time lead), and document engagement meetings with portfolio companiesConduct data gathering, benchmarking, and reporting to inform voting decisions, policy positions, and position papers that facilitate discussion with broader BlackRock audiencesCollaborate across the team to improve policy, enhance team knowledge, and streamline business processesRepresent BlackRock with the professionalism and gravitas required when engaging senior leadership of portfolio companiesThe tasks involved in fulfilling these responsibilities include:Monitoring policy developments relevant to covered industries and governance ecosystem to improve the quality of engagement and relevance of BlackRock's principles and guidelinesPreparing for engagement with senior representatives of portfolio companies, including crafting memos in preparation for meetings- highlighting key data that will be useful in our engagement and stewardship effortsCommunicating clearly, concisely and with keen attention to factual detail and regulatory and policy-based contextAttending, documenting and leading (as needed) engagement efforts, including recording research notes to be stored and shared with select audiences across BlackRockAnalyzing companies' shareholder meeting agendas and related materials in order to vote in the manner most consistent with BlackRock's corporate governance policies and fiduciary responsibilitiesMonitoring of proxy voting workflow to ensure all accounts are voted as intended and are in accordance with the appropriate guidelinesSupporting the development of BIS position papers and reporting including collaborating with client-facing, data and analytics, and communications colleagues to ensure internal and external collateral is accurate and robust and accurately represents BIS’ insights and reflectionsMaintaining continuous learning and sector oversight to ensure risks are minimized and performance optimizedQualifications: An undergraduate degree in finance, economics, accounting, or other relevant fieldsA minimum of 2-4 years of experience in a financial services focused role, ideally with a demonstrated strong understanding of financial statements, corporate finance, and capital marketsStrong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information and convey it in a clear and concise manner to senior-level audiencesA diligent, focused, and consistent work ethic to implement while leading multiple tasks and changing prioritiesThe ability to prioritize, analyze, and resolve complex issues under time pressure while maintaining consistent attention to detailAn organized, self-reliant, and self-motivated approach to responsibilitiesA keen interest in corporate governance and material, sustainable business practices, ideally in relation to the financial services and/or real estate sectorsCollaborative and non-competitive working style, and strong interpersonal skills demonstrating the ability to build and maintain successful relationships with colleagues across the firm and with external partiesProficiency using Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and other Microsoft productsAI & LLM literacy and fluency in crafting effective prompts preferred For NY7 - 50 Hudson Yards, New York Only the salary range for this position is USD$105,000.00 - USD$137,500.00 . Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, and benefits including healthcare, leave benefits, and retirement benefits. BlackRock operates a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy and your total compensation may vary based on role, location, and firm, department and individual performance. Our benefitsTo help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.Our hybrid work modelBlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.Guidance on AI use for candidatesAt BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.About BlackRockAt BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.BlackRock is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. About this role

Function Description

The BlackRock Investment Stewardship team (BIS) operates across three regions – the Americas (New York, Washington DC, Wilmington and San Francisco); Europe, Middle East and Africa (London); and Asia-Pacific (Tokyo, Hong Kong, Singapore and Sydney) – and undertakes engagement with and proxy voting at portfolio companies on behalf of index clients globally.

As a team of high performing specialists globally, BIS is proud of our global reach and local presence.

Team Overview

Investment stewardship is one way BlackRock fulfills our fiduciary responsibilities as an asset manager to our clients. BlackRock Investment Stewardship serves as a link between our clients and the companies they invest in. We take a long-term approach to stewardship, focused on engaging with company boards and executive leadership to understand the drivers of risk and financial value creation in companies’ business models. Our sole focus when we engage with companies or vote at shareholder meetings is to advance our clients’ financial interests. As part of our fiduciary duty to our clients, we consider it one of our responsibilities to promote sound corporate governance as an informed, engaged shareholder on their behalf.

Role Overview

The BIS Investment Stewardship Professional will assist the lead analyst covering companies in Financial Services and/or Real Estate (REITs) sectors. They will provide support on portfolio company analysis, engagement, and voting. The intention is for the person in this role to ultimately specialize in a subset of the companies in the given sector, along with various aspects of relevant policy, to support the delivery of our annual and long-term objectives. They will work alongside the lead sector analyst for that industry and report to the Deputy Head of the Stewardship team in the Americas.

Key responsibilities:

  • Demonstrate sector expertise across financial services (banking, insurance, capital markets, consumer finance, diversified financials) and real estate (REITs), including pertaining to corporate governance, material market trends, regulatory developments, and sustainability practices

  • Learn and apply BIS engagement priorities and proxy voting guidelines in order to apply consistent judgment in engagement and voting

  • Partner with lead sector analyst(s) to execute engagement and voting responsibilities to further the long-term financial interests of our clients

  • Prepare for, assist (and in time lead), and document engagement meetings with portfolio companies

  • Conduct data gathering, benchmarking, and reporting to inform voting decisions, policy positions, and position papers that facilitate discussion with broader BlackRock audiences

  • Collaborate across the team to improve policy, enhance team knowledge, and streamline business processes

  • Represent BlackRock with the professionalism and gravitas required when engaging senior leadership of portfolio companies

The tasks involved in fulfilling these responsibilities include:

  • Monitoring policy developments relevant to covered industries and governance ecosystem to improve the quality of engagement and relevance of BlackRock's principles and guidelines

  • Preparing for engagement with senior representatives of portfolio companies, including crafting memos in preparation for meetings- highlighting key data that will be useful in our engagement and stewardship efforts

  • Communicating clearly, concisely and with keen attention to factual detail and regulatory and policy-based context

  • Attending, documenting and leading (as needed) engagement efforts, including recording research notes to be stored and shared with select audiences across BlackRock

  • Analyzing companies' shareholder meeting agendas and related materials in order to vote in the manner most consistent with BlackRock's corporate governance policies and fiduciary responsibilities

  • Monitoring of proxy voting workflow to ensure all accounts are voted as intended and are in accordance with the appropriate guidelines

  • Supporting the development of BIS position papers and reporting including collaborating with client-facing, data and analytics, and communications colleagues to ensure internal and external collateral is accurate and robust and accurately represents BIS’ insights and reflections

  • Maintaining continuous learning and sector oversight to ensure risks are minimized and performance optimized

Qualifications:

  • An undergraduate degree in finance, economics, accounting, or other relevant fields

  • A minimum of 2-4 years of experience in a financial services focused role, ideally with a demonstrated strong understanding of financial statements, corporate finance, and capital markets

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information and convey it in a clear and concise manner to senior-level audiences

  • A diligent, focused, and consistent work ethic to implement while leading multiple tasks and changing priorities

  • The ability to prioritize, analyze, and resolve complex issues under time pressure while maintaining consistent attention to detail

  • An organized, self-reliant, and self-motivated approach to responsibilities

  • A keen interest in corporate governance and material, sustainable business practices, ideally in relation to the financial services and/or real estate sectors

  • Collaborative and non-competitive working style, and strong interpersonal skills demonstrating the ability to build and maintain successful relationships with colleagues across the firm and with external parties

  • Proficiency using Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and other Microsoft products

  • AI & LLM literacy and fluency in crafting effective prompts preferred

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. content.Title: Candidate Experience | Datadog Careers
content.MainContent: The CandidateExperienceThe moment you submit an application at Datadog, we strive to make you feel part of the pack. That’s why we’re dedicated to creating a remarkable candidate experience. Learn more about our interview process, tips for success, and FAQs around our candidate journey here.The Interview ProcessWhile our process differs slightly depending on the roles, teams, and departments you’re interviewing with, here is the high-level structure we follow across the company to ensure you have the opportunity to connect with as many Datadogs as possible before deciding if this role is the right next step for you. Please note that one of the steps is expected to happen in person.123456Initial ScreenThis is an initial conversation for our hiring team to get to know you and for you to share your aspirations for this career opportunity with us. In most cases, this first conversation will take place by phone or Zoom with the recruiter and or Hiring Manager for the role.Face-to-Face InterviewDepending on the role you're interviewing for, this stage may consist of multiple rounds or panels. There, you will meet your interviewers in person. Many teams have both on-site and remote employees. If an interviewer is remote, part of your on-site interview could still be conducted via Zoom.Be prepared to check in with the front desk so a recruiting team member can come get you. During your time in the office, you’ll get the opportunity to check out our collaborative workspace during a quick office tour so you can see what it's like to work at Datadog!Don't hesitate to be curious about Datadog employees and take a look at life at Datadog through our website, Linkedin, Github, and Instagram.INTERVIEWING AT DATADOG: AI GUIDELINESAt Datadog, we’re proud to be a technology-driven company that embraces innovation, including the thoughtful use of AI. However, when it comes to our interview process, we believe in building a genuine connection with each candidate—one that reflects your own experience, skills, and perspective.To ensure a fair and authentic process for everyone, we’ve set clear guidelines around the appropriate use of AI tools during interviews. By participating in the interview process at Datadog, you agree to follow this policy. Misuse of AI tools, or failure to disclose their use, may lead to disqualification from consideration.Learn MoreEQUAL OPPORTUNITYAt Datadog, diversity means making a conscious effort to reflect the many experiences and identities of the world outside, while treating each other with fairness and without bias. Inclusion is the choice we make every day to foster an environment where people of all backgrounds not only belong, but excel, so that together, as a company, we can succeed.Datadog is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable legal requirements. If you’re applying for a position in San Francisco or Los Angeles, review the guidelines applicable in your area. What if I don't know which position is the best fit for me?You are more than welcome to apply to multiple positions at once. Our recruiting team works collaboratively. If we think you’d be a better fit for another position, we will forward your information to the appropriate recruiter.When will I hear about next steps?Your recruiter will be in touch shortly after your interview to inform you of next steps and expected timelines. If you have any questions surrounding next steps, please reach out to your recruiter. Please also be sure to communicate any deadlines you may have on your end.Does Datadog offer interviews onsite?Yes! For certain roles and office hubs, we’re excited to once again offer candidates the opportunity to interview onsite to see what Datadog life is truly like. This part of the interview process would occur during the face-to-face portion of the interview, or anytime after. Your recruiter or coordinator will help set up all the logistics.Will I be required to travel for the interview process?If you’re traveling for your interview, as discussed with your recruiter, you will book your travel through our partner, TripActions, and will be set up by your recruiter and recruiting coordinator.Is there a dress code?We do not have a company dress code at Datadog. We want you to feel comfortable and confident on the day of your interview at Datadog, and so we recommend that you wear whatever makes you feel your best.What do Datadog's benefits look like?At Datadog, we believe our employees should have the support they need to maintain a strong work/life balance, grow personally and professionally, and save for their future. You can browse a high-level summary of our workplace benefits here.(For non-remote positions) If hired, how often will I be required to be in the office?If hired for a role in one of our offices or co-working locations, you will be expected to come into the office for part of the week per our hybrid model. The amount of days required varies by team, and we encourage our employees to go into office as often as they can. Check out Datadog’s virtual office tours above!What does the virtual interviewing experience look like?We utilize Zoom as our virtual interviewing platform so that you can meet with your interviewers face to face. You’ll receive one Zoom link per interview, and you’ll stay on that same Zoom link if you’re meeting with multiple Datadogs during your interview panel. Your recruiter will keep in touch throughout the process to ensure you are comfortable during your interview.How can I go about requesting reasonable accommodations for my interview?We strive to make sure everyone feels welcome and is set up for success. Our compliance and recruiting team will be happy to help set up any reasonable accommodations you need throughout the process.If you would like to request a reasonable accommodation, please submit this form and our team will be happy to assist. If you have additional questions related to reasonable accommodations, you can reach out to us at accommodation-requests@datadoghq.com.I was reached out to by Datadog, but believe it’s a scam.Unfortunately, recruiting scams happen. Most commonly, we see this scam in the form of imposter accounts on messaging apps. Please be wary if you receive a message that asks for personal information. Datadog will only collect personal information through our website (datadoghq.com) and/or Greenhouse application form. And if you aren’t sure whether a message is a scam or not, please reach out to Datadog’s Recruiting Solutions team to verify the message’s authenticity.Some warning signs that the message you received could be a scam include:Requests for personal details outside of an application: By law, every Datadog candidate has to fill out an application for the role they’re applying to via Datadog’s careers site. This provides us with the only personal information we need to process your employment at the interview stage. We will never ask for this information in a text message or email.The message comes from a messaging app: Datadog’s recruiters will only ever first approach you using their datadoghq.com email or LinkedIn account with their name and contact information clearly visible. Be wary of other messaging platforms, especially if they ask you for personal information through the messaging app.Learn More About #DatadogLifeCheck out the additional links and resources below for more information on what makes Datadog, Datadog—from our people and culture to our product and customers.Datadog Customers & Case StudiesDatadog’s Pup Culture BlogDiversity, Equity, and Inclusion at DatadogDatadog Learning CenterStay Connected

Because Datadog is at the forefront of the evolving cloud monitoring and security spaces, our team is routinely asked to analyze complex legal questions presented by new uses of data and technology in partnership with other teams with different skills. So if you’re looking for the opportunity to work on varied and meaningful projects in a collaborative environment, I highly recommend that you consider a career at Datadog.Aschta P. (she/her)People Operations, ParisWhat I love about Datadog is working with so many people who are passionate about what they do and always strive to do the best they can. All with a strong team spirit and kindness. The team I am part of reflects this state of mind well. We have grown up so quickly, getting to know each other mainly through Zoom and yet our team is strong and tight-knit. Happy and proud to be part of this team.Patrick C. (he/him)Sales Operations, BostonComing in to work for Datadog each day means coming in ready to learn something new that day and each day following. In doing this, you get the opportunity to collaborate with some of the smartest individuals to tackle some very challenging problems and contribute to a product that is of unmatched quality. I truly believe that we will reshape the way people monitor their tech stacks forever.Alison V.Technical Recruiting, ParisAs Technical Recruiter we have a chance to be part of the change regarding representation of underrepresented minorities in tech. Interviewing at Datadog, I was convinced that this company is a unique environment where everyone can influence and build the company they'd like to work in. It's been 2 years and I'm even more convinced about our company's mission and my role, and I'm proud of the impact I have as a Tech Recruiter.Lauren F.Finance, New YorkAt Datadog, I love working with friendly and vibrant people who are full of great ideas, and who are from across many different departments! content.Title: Graduate Programme – Deutsche Bank Careers
content.MainContent: Pause Graduate Programme You are here: Home Students and Graduates Graduate Programme The Deutsche Bank Graduate Programme is a year-long comprehensive programme designed to provide you with exposure to a range of fascinating projects and ongoing professional and technical training to develop the skills you need to grow your career. You’ll feel supported by a network of peers and mentors and benefit from our global wellbeing programme. We offer our Graduate Programme across various business divisions and infrastructure areas – The Unofficial Guide to Banking will help you to understand the best fit for you. To be eligible for the 2027 Graduate Programme you must: Complete your studies between 1st January 2026 and 31st July 2027. Be able to start full time work in July 2027, subject to local working legislation and visa requirements. Possess no more than 12 months full-time, relevant work experience. Apply now Pre-Programme Learning You’ll be given early access e-learning - an interactive module where you’ll find out about our values, our impact, and our people. In addition, you’ll receive tailored pre-learning related to your specific divisional programme. Orientation Before you join your teams, you’ll be introduced to Deutsche Bank through various activities and simulations with the graduate class, where you’ll learn about our structure, strategy and culture. You’ll also hear directly from our Management Board and senior leaders on topics like Sustainability, AI, career growth and the future of work. Well-being At Deutsche Bank we aim to create a health-promoting and caring work environment where you can be yourself, feel supported and happy, so you can perform at your best and thrive in your career. Our Well-being programme will provide you with the tools and methods to reduce stress and anxiety in and outside the workplace and raise awareness of mental and physical health and wellness topics. Networking We recognise the importance of networking for new graduates so we’ll create formal and informal opportunities for you to connect with your peers and colleagues early on in the programme. Our Graduate Networking Committee also organise events for the graduate class on an ongoing basis. Divisional Training You’ll be immersed in tailored, interactive training related to your specific divisional programme ensuring you feel confident on the first day with your team. This will continue on a formal basis throughout your first year and beyond. Continuous Development Programme We’re committed to investing in your continuous development and from day one you’ll be focused on enhancing your personal brand, self-awareness, teamwork, and collaboration skills. Throughout the course of your first year, you’ll join regular training sessions designed to support the development of your professional skills. Joining your team There’s no replacement for on-the-job learning – as soon as you join your team, you’ll learn first-hand from some of the industry’s top minds and thought leaders and build a valuable network of experts along the way. content.Title: Cost Controller - Ennismore Careers
content.MainContent: Take me back Cost Controller SO/ - Ras Al-Khaimah Apply Company DescriptionSO/ Ras Al Khaimah is part of a coveted collection of hotels rooted in the world of fashion, commanding attention with it’s avant-garde design and creative approach to the world of luxury. This is a place where we celebrate brilliant individuals – you, our SO/ Icons. Welcome to your invite to the Front Row, a place where self-expression and experience count in equal measure.Job Description• Cost Monitoring: Monitor, analyze, and control costs across all departments, including food and beverage, housekeeping, and maintenance, to ensure budget adherence. • Budgeting & Forecasting: Assist in the preparation of departmental budgets and forecasts. Monitor actual performance against the budget and analyze variances to ensure financial targets are met. • Cost Reporting: Prepare and present detailed cost reports, including profit and loss statements, cost analysis, and variance reports, to senior management. • Inventory Management: Oversee inventory control, including conducting regular physical counts of inventory, and ensure accurate recording of goods received and used. • Standard Costing: Establish and maintain standard costs for materials, supplies, and services. Ensure that all cost standards are regularly reviewed and updated. • Supplier Negotiations: Assist in negotiating with suppliers to secure the best possible pricing and ensure cost-effective procurement of goods and services. • Cost Analysis: Analyze cost trends, identify areas of inefficiency, and make recommendations for cost-saving initiatives without compromising quality or guest satisfaction. Qualifications• Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. • Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in cost control, accounting, or finance, preferably in the hospitality industry. • Technical Skills: Proficiency in accounting software (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics, SAP), hotel management systems (such as Opera or Micros), and Microsoft Office Suite (particularly Excel). • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail, with the ability to analyze complex financial data and identify cost-saving opportunities. • Analytical Skills: Ability to interpret financial data, perform variance analysis, and provide actionable insights to improve cost efficiency. • Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify cost issues and provide solutions that enhance profitability. • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and management. • Time Management: Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize deadlines, and work under pressure. • Confidentiality: Ability to maintain confidentiality regarding financial data and sensitive operational information. 1. content.Title: Arbeiten bei Evotec München
content.MainContent: Suchen Stichwortsuche Ort, Region oder PLZ Suchen Servus München München ist eine Stadt voller Kontraste: die pulsierende Aufregung der Großstadt und die ruhige Schönheit der Natur. Berühmt für das Oktoberfest und den Englischen Garten, aber auch bekannt für historische Wahrzeichen wie das Schloss Nymphenburg und die Frauenkirche. Außerhalb der Stadt locken die malerischen Landschaften Bayerns, von sanften Hügeln bis zu den Ufern des Starnberger Sees. Münchens kultureller Reichtum, natürliche Schönheit und lebendige Energie machen es zu einem Ziel für Abenteurer und Romantiker gleichermaßen. Jobs finden Unser Standort befindet sich auf dem Campus Neuried, nur 20 Minuten vom Stadtzentrum Münchens entfernt. Wir arbeiten in einem neuen und modernen Gebäude, unsere Büros und Labore sind geräumig und gut ausgestattet. Genieße dein Mittagessen in unserer Kantine oder in einem der schönen Restaurants oder Cafés auf dem Campus. Hier arbeitet ein engagiertes Team von über 60 Wissenschaftler:innen und technischen Expert:innen daran, das Feld der massenspektrometrie-basierten Proteomik und Bioinformatik voranzutreiben. content.Title: Hiring FAQs
content.MainContent: Hiring FAQs Learn more Where do I apply online? Search: You can search for jobs by using the "Jobs" button at the top of this page. Search by keyword, location or job category.Click: The job title to learn more about the role. Apply: Click "Apply Now" and you'll be prompted to log in or register to submit your application. I was just contacted about a job with Fiserv but never applied. Is this legitimate? Recruitment fraud is a deceptive practice in which malicious actors use fake job listings to manipulate job applicants into disclosing personal data or providing payment as part of the recruitment process. Fake job listings are often falsely portrayed as originating from well-known companies and may be communicated in multiple ways including web sites, email and phone calls.We are aware of instances of fake job listings that claim to originate from Fiserv, but that do not in fact originate from Fiserv and are not approved by Fiserv. We will not send a job applicant a check; however, a fraudulent recruiter may promise to do so in an effort to obtain the job applicant's financial account information.All emails from Fiserv have email addresses ending in "@fiserv.com."You will never be asked for payment in order to be considered for a job at Fiserv, or asked for financial account details or personal information, without first being asked to apply for a position through Fiserv.com/careers or interviews using third-party sites such as Zoom or Google Hangouts.If anyone presenting themselves as a recruiter claims their use of non-Fiserv email accounts or third-party video communication sites, it may be recruitment fraud.Our hiring process typically takes several weeks. Therefore, if someone presenting themselves as a recruiter indicates the process must be completed in a short time frame, it may be recruitment fraud. To avoid recruitment fraud, please be aware of these details of our recruitment process:If you think you have been a victim of recruiting fraud, you may notify the Federal Trade Commission.If you think you have encountered someone falsely representing themselves as a Fiserv representative, please email: JSOC@fiserv.com. How long will it take to complete the application? If you have a resume ready to upload or will apply using your LinkedIn Profile, this can take as little as five minutes. If you are manually inputting your background, experience, education and skills, the process will take a little longer; however, it shouldn't take more than 15 minutes. Either way you apply, please make sure you include as much detail about your education, experience and skills as you can to ensure the recruiter can effectively match you to the requirements of a position. What information should I include in my application? The system only requires you to input your name and contact information and then answer some basic demographic questions; however, for the best chance of getting to the next steps, make sure you include your previous experience, education and skills. When adding your education, please keep in mind that most of our jobs require a high school diploma or equivalent and some positions may require an associate's degree or higher. You can provide this by attaching a resume, using your LinkedIn profile or manually adding this information into the application. Why don’t Fiserv job postings contain a pay scale? Some Fiserv job postings do contain a pay scale for the position where required by applicable law. At Fiserv, we believe in a performance-based compensation philosophy. Every position, based on level in the organization, has a potential pay range, which will vary based on past skills, experience, location and market conditions. Because of this variability, we encourage an open discussion about compensation requirements with your recruiter. As well, Fiserv compensation includes more than wage and base salary. For more information on our total rewards packages, visit our Benefits page. I was referred by a friend who works for Fiserv. Where do I put this information? We're thrilled when our associates share opportunities via referrals. First, in the "How did you hear about us?" section of the application, be sure to select "Associate Referral." You'll be prompted to include the associate's full name in a separate field. I have an interview. What can I do to prepare? Congratulations — your skills and experience have brought you this far. Remember, being prepared for an interview can set you apart from your competition. Here are some tips and tricks from some of our recruiters:Be punctual; if you are having an in-person interview, give yourself extra time to get thereMake a good first impression, dress professionallyBe yourselfBring a portfolio of your work if it's applicable to the opportunityUnderstand the duties and responsibilities of the role for which you are interviewingResearch the company ahead of time and understand the businessPrepare questions that you may have for the interview in advance What is the interview style at Fiserv? Our hiring managers employ several different styles of interviewing, based on the role within the company. If you are chosen for an interview, your recruiter will prep you for the interview types that you will go through. Many interviewers will ask you to describe specific examples where you have demonstrated certain competencies following the STAR approach.Situation - What was the role, what company and whenTask - What was the challenge, problem or issueAction - What actions did you take specifically to overcome the problemResult - What was the outcome and were there any measure of success Will I be notified when a job has been filled? We strive to communicate with all candidates about the status of their application. Your Candidate Home profile will show you the current status of your application, and you may also receive an email. Some emails my be delivered to you via the system; therefore, you will want to ensure emails from fiserv@workday.com do not end up in your junk/spam folder. What if I need an ADA accommodation to apply for a position with Fiserv? Fiserv strives to make this site accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding accessibility of our website or need a reasonable accommodation in completing the application process, please call Fiserv at 877-527-5372, or contact us by email to: AskHR.us@fiserv.com, or by mail at: Fiserv, Inc., 600 N. Vel R. Phillips Ave, Milwaukee, WI 53203, Attn: Corporate Human Resources, Applicant Assistance. ¿Habrá una verificación de antecedentes antes de empezar a contratar? Due to the nature of our business, Fiserv requires background checks on all applicants who have accepted an offer with us. These screens typically include drug test, criminal check, credit history, employment and education verification and personal references. Other screens may be applicable based on the position for which you are applying and where you live; your recruiter will go through these with you at the appropriate time in the process.Successful completion of these screens is required prior to your start date. HireRight is our background check vendor for North America, LATAM, APAC and EMEA. Feel free to check out HireRight's Candidate Background Check FAQ page to learn more about their processes. If you have specific concerns regarding your background and would like further information, please talk with your recruiter or ask to speak with a Human Resources manager. What happens if I do not pass my credit history check? If employment is denied because of information in a consumer report, Fiserv will advise you in writing and give you the name and address of the reporting agency making the consumer report, a copy of the report and a copy of a "Summary of Your Rights Under the Fair Credit Reporting Act." A sense of mutual respect and mindfulness permeates our culture-in fact, it’s the key to our success. Learn more Back

content.Title: Cookie Policy - Frankenburg Technologies Group
content.MainContent: Cookie Policy This site is provided by Frankenburg Technologies Group. Frankenburg Technologies Group (“we”, “us”) use cookies and similar technologies (jointly referred to as “cookies”) on this site. This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are, why they are used, and your choices regarding their use. For more information on how Frankenburg Technologies Group processes personal data on this career site, please visit Frankenburg Technologies Group’s Privacy Policy here. What are cookies? A cookie is a small file containing a string of characters that is sent to your computer when you visit a website. When you visit the site again, the cookie allows that site to recognise your browser. This way, the information you previously provided can be retrieved. Cookies may store user preferences and other information to enhance your experience on the site or be used to track you when you navigate to other sites. What types of cookies are used on this site? Strictly necessary cookies: These cookies are necessary to make the site work properly. Analytics cookies: These cookies collect information that is used to help us understand how the site is being used. What cookies are used on this site? Name Type Vendor Expires after Description _tt_session Strictly necessary Teamtailor 2 days This cookie is used to keep the context of a visitor (e.g. to keep you logged in on the site). referrer Analytics Teamtailor Session This cookie is used to identify the web link used to direct visitors to the site. _ttCookiePermissions Strictly necessary Teamtailor 6 months This cookie is used to hide the cookie banner once you have interacted with it. _ttAnalytics Analytics Teamtailor 6 months This cookie is used to gather insights about how visitors use the site. Your control of cookies You have the right to decide whether to accept or reject cookies that are not strictly necessary. You can do so by: Indicating your preference on the banner that appears when you enter the site. Clicking “Cookie Preferences” on the banner that appears when you enter the site, to tailor your preferences. Changing your already selected preferences by clicking the link “Manage Cookies”, which is always available at the bottom of the site. Restricting cookies by altering your browser settings. The way in which you can restrict cookies varies from browser to browser. You should therefore visit your web browser's help menu for more information. Contact us If you have any questions about this Cookie Policy, please email Frankenburg Technologies Group at sigrid.sinnep@frankenburg.tech. The Cookie Policy for this career site was last updated on January 13, 2025.

In this role, you will perform simulations and engineering calculations using FEA and analytical methods, assess metal and composite structures, and provide analysis reports to support qualification and safety activities. Working closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, you will help optimise designs, evaluate test results, and contribute to the delivery of reliable, high-performance defence products.At Frankenburg, you will join an exceptional team of leading experts in technology and national defence, building next-generation defence missile systems for the free world. You will work in a fast-paced environment where your contribution shapes how we verify and demonstrate advanced defence systems. If you thrive on innovation and impact — we want to hear from you.Key Responsibilities Structural Analysis & SimulationPerform structural strength, stiffness, and fatigue analyses of missile and launcher components using FEA and analytical methods to predict and validate structural performance.Qualification SupportPrepare analysis reports and strength documentation to support verification, qualification, and safety activities.Design OptimisationWork closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to improve designs, evaluate trade-offs, and enhance structural performance throughout the product lifecycle.Testing & ValidationAnalyse test results and structural failures to validate simulations and support design improvements.Documentation & TraceabilityMaintain clear and traceable records of structural analyses, engineering assumptions, requirements, and supporting documentation in line with company processes.We Would Love You to HaveExperiencePrevious experience in structural analysis, fatigue calculations, and mechanical design of metallic and composite structures, preferably in aerospace, UAV or space applications.Technical ExpertiseProficiency with FEA and 3D CAD software (ANSYS, Nastran, SolidWorks etc), structural and fatigue analysis, and a strong theoretical understanding of structural mechanics. Familiarity with defence industry standards (MIL-STD, STANAG) is a plus.Soft SkillsProactive, solution-oriented mindset with exceptional communication skills. Delivery-focused, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.Mission AlignmentStrong alignment with our mission to build affordable and mass-manufacturable defence technologies — ensuring every euro spent moves us closer to our goal. Security ClearanceWillingness to undergo a background check as a condition of employment. Open to RelocateWillingness to relocate to Tallinn.Our ValuesOur mission is ambitious, and it takes a team that works with the same intensity.Own the Mission: Mission first. We fix it now — when delays or problems appear, we step up, rally the right people, and solve them immediately. We keep momentum — when time matters, we stay focused and move forward without waiting for perfect conditions.Strive for More: Dare more. Do more. Achieve the impossible.We challenge the status quo — we question, test, and improve instead of accepting “the usual way.” We embrace discomfort — we step outside comfort zones and turn challenges into growth. We anticipate the future — we build solutions that scale and set higher standards each time.Build with Trust: Be open. Keep promises.We walk the talk — what we say, we do. No excuses, no exceptions. We share openly — we communicate clearly and early, even when the news is hard. We own outcomes — we admit errors quickly, fix them, and prevent them from repeating.Ready to Make a Real Impact?Apply now! The deadline is August 7, 2026, but we review applications and reach out to qualified candidates continuously. Department Engineering Role Structural Engineering Locations Tallinn, Estonia Remote status Hybrid About Frankenburg Technologies Group Frankenburg Technologies a is a European defence technology company building affordable, mass-manufacturable guided missile systems for modern air and missile defence.This is a demanding engineering and manufacturing challenge. Guided missile systems must be precise, reliable and safe to operate, while also being affordable enough to use against mass aerial threats and producible in quantity.Frankenburg's first system, Mark I, is a guided interceptor missile, designed to defeat unmanned aerial systems, including drone swarms, at close range.Alongside missile development, Frankenburg is building the factories, supply chains and production processes needed to produce missiles in quantity and replenish them quickly.Headquartered in Tallinn, Estonia, Frankenburg operates in Latvia, the United Kingdom and Germany, with further European presence in Lithuania, Poland and Denmark.Join us in building the world’s next missile house. content.MainContent: HomeJobsTestOps Engineer (KSC)Testing Automation | SDETDevelopment PythonRussian FederationMoscowPythonLinuxTestOps Engineer (KSC)ApplyМы разрабатываем высокопроизводительную систему класса SIEM, построенную на микросервисной архитектуре, способную обрабатывать сотни тысяч событий информационной безопасности за одну секунду и предоставляющую все необходимые инструменты для их анализа.Мы ищем многопрофильного человека, который будет работать на стыке DevOps и тестирования. Это подход, который берет принципы DevOps (непрерывная интеграция, автоматизация, прозрачность) и применяет их к управлению, масштабированию и оптимизации тестирования, а также его автоматизации.Задачи:Развитие и поддержка тестовой инфраструктуры, включая микросервисы, написанные на Python.Реагирование на инциденты и осуществление их анализа.Разработка, поддержка и развитие CI/CD пайплайнов.Автоматизация процессов развертывания операционных систем и сервисов.Реализация базовых и специфичных требований информационной безопасности.﻿﻿Исследование случаев деградации продукта.Тестирование и автоматизация всех видов функционального и нефункционального тестирования, включая нагрузочное.Что мы ожидаем:Уверенное администрирование Linux.Глубокие знания Docker и Kubernetes.﻿﻿Способность логически мыслить и делать обоснованные выводы.﻿﻿Умение работать с огромным количеством чужого кода.﻿﻿Уверенное знание Bash, Python.Практический опыт настройки CI/CD.﻿﻿Опыт анализа производительности и профилирования кода (желательно).Apply for a jobFields marked with * are requiredData privacy statement kaspersky lab career site (careers.kaspersky.com)Data Controller InformationAO Kaspersky Lab, located at address: 39A/3 Leningradskoe Shosse, Moscow 125212, Russian Federation (“Kaspersky”, “Kaspersky Lab”, “KL” or “we”)If you have any questions regarding the processing of your personal information, please contact our Kaspersky Lab EU representative via e-mail or phone: Kaspersky Labs GmbH, Ingolstadt, Germany, info@kaspersky.de, +49 (0) 841 98 18 90If you have any additional questions about Kaspersky Lab’s privacy practices or if you would like us to update information or preferences you provided to us, please contact our Data Protection Officer – click here. content.Title: Besiktningsingenjör inom lyft till Jönköping!
content.MainContent: Besiktningsingenjör inom lyft till Jönköping! Jönköping, Sweden Ansök till tjänsten Ansök nu Detaljer om jobbet Funktion Inspection Typ av tjänst On Site/Office Arbetstid 40 Jobbsammanfattning Är du vår nästa stjärna inom lyftsäkerhet? Med en varierande vardag och frihet under ansvar kan du bli en del av vår Kiwa-gemenskap som Besiktningsingenjör! Om rollen Vill du bli en del av vårt besiktningsgäng i Jönköping?Vårt team i Jönköping söker en ny kollega till vårt besiktningsgäng inom lyft! Hos oss får du chansen att arbeta med spännande uppdrag där fokus ligger på besiktning av lyftanordningar så som kranar, traverser, hissar, grävmaskiner osv. Kanske har du redan gjort besiktningar tidigare – eller så är du redo att ta steget mot en ny spännande karriär som besiktningsingenjör. Ditt arbete är viktigt: du bidrar till att skapa en tryggare vardag för våra kunder, samtidigt som du självständigt planerar och ta ansvar för ditt eget arbete. Som besiktningsingenjör hos oss får du använda ditt tekniska intresse samtidigt som du möter människor och bygger relationer. Du planerar självständigt ditt arbete, är ute på fältet och ser till att dokumentera dina besiktningar på ett tydligt och strukturerat sätt. Vi tror att du är en person som ser utmaningar som en chans att utvecklas och växa – både i din yrkesroll och som individ. För att du ska känna dig trygg och få en bra start erbjuder vi löpande utbildningar under din första tid på Kiwa. På så sätt kan du hela tiden bygga vidare på din kunskap och fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med oss.Vi har kunder inom de flesta branscher, allt från tung industri till sjukhus, köpcentrum och flygbranschen. Det här ger dig möjlighet att inspektera olika typer av lyftanordningar:Kranar och traverser Hissar och rulltrappor PortarGrävmaskiner, hjullastare och entreprenadmaskinerVindkraftverkSkidliftar Du utgår från hemmet med anställningsort Jönköping. Tjänsterna innefattar dagliga resor och även resor med övernattning kan förekomma. Har du vad som krävs? För att trivas i rollen ser vi att du har ett tekniskt intresse, gärna med erfarenhet eller utbildning inom relevant område. Vi tror att du tycker om ett socialt arbete där du dagligen möter kunder och arbetar självständigt. För att lyckas som Besiktningsingenjör är du lyhörd, nyfiken, driven och noggrann. Vi tror att med intresse och grundkunskap kommer du långt därför lägger vi stor vikt vid din personlighet. Under din första tid hos oss kommer du att genomgå utbildningar på annan ort för att få den kunskap du behöver för att utföra dina arbetsuppgifter på bästa sätt. Vi ser att du har: Teknisk gymnasieutbildning eller motsvarande, ex yrkesutbildningFörmåga att ta dig an nya utmaningar och arbeta lösningsorienterat.Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska såväl i tal som skriftB-körkortDet är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av besiktningsbranschen eller har jobbat med kranar, entreprenadmaskiner, mobila arbetsplattformar, hissar, vindkraftverk eller likvärdigt. Vad kan du förvänta dig av oss i gengäld? Kiwa är idag ett av de mest framgångsrika företagen inom besiktning, provning, certifiering och teknisk konsultation vilket är tack vare våra medarbetare som genom sitt engagemang och sin kunskap bidrar med säkerhet och hållbarhet till våra kunder och även till samhället. Därför satsar Kiwa mycket på sina anställda och deras utveckling. Genom ditt dagliga arbete, intressanta projekt och utbildningar kommer du och din kompetens ständigt att utvecklas när du är en del av Kiwa! Hos oss är laget före jaget viktigt och tillsammans skapar vi en positiv arbetsmiljö där vi alla är en del av en större gemenskap, Kiwa-gemenskapen! Trygg och stabil anställning- Kiwa har kollektivavtal Generöst friskvårdsbidrag Ersättning för bland annat läkarvård, vaccinationer och möjlighet till en grundlig hälsoanalys En timbank så du kan vara ledig när du vill- inte bara när kalenderns röda dagar infaller Skicka in din ansökan och bli en del av vårt engagerade team! Så här söker duAnsök via vår hemsida och registrera ditt CV.Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. För frågor gällande rollen kontakta enhetschef Joakim Junehed på tfn. 010-4793838 eller maila rekryteringsansvarig Sofia Kjellström på sofia.kjellstrom@kiwa.com Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Inför den här rekryteringen har vi noga övervägt våra annonseringsvägar och vill därför undanbe oss kontakt med rekryterings- och annonsförsäljare. Om KiwaWe ARE Kiwa- Är du?För oss på Kiwa är vår värdegrund, ARE, utgångspunkten i allt vi gör. Ambitious, Reliable och Engaged. Känner du dig bekväm i vår värdegrund, strävar efter att skapa förtroende och trovärdighet mot kund och hos dina medarbetare och är samhällets och individens säkerhet i samhället viktigt för dig?Kiwa är idag ett av de mest framgångsrika företagen inom besiktning, provning, certifiering och teknisk konsultation. Vi är en global aktör med lokal förankring. Vi har starka kundrelationer och hög service med ett fokus på säkerhet, teknik och hållbarhet. Vi har ett brett utbud och erbjuder tjänster inom processäkerhet, fastighets- och lyftsäkerhet, lantbruk samt inom livsmedels- och byggbranschen. Som koncern är vi verksamma i över 40 länder och har ca 12 000 anställda runt om i världen. I Sverige har vi ett tjugotal kontor mellan Kiruna och Malmö där totalt 900 medarbetare arbetar tillsammans för ett säkrare samhälle. Övrig informationKiwas målsättning är att ha en arbetsplats som är drogfri. Därför genomför vi slumpmässiga alkohol- och drogtester under året.Bakgrundskontroller förekommer under rekryteringsprocessen och kandidaten informeras innan och ger samtycke.
