Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre aussagekräftige Bewerbung. Wir begrüßen eine Bewerbung ohne Foto. Wir akzeptieren laufend Bewerbungen und streben an, die Stelle zum 01.09.2026 zu besetzen. Wir befinden uns in einem fortlaufenden Prozess des Kulturwandels und zu mehr Diversität und wünschen uns auch Bewerbungen von Menschen, die von struktureller Diskriminierung betroffen sind oder sein könnten. Anerkannte Schwerbehinderte und ihnen gleichgestellte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Bitte weisen Sie auf eine Schwerbehinderung gegebenenfalls bereits in der Bewerbung hin. Bei Fragen wenden Sie sich gern an bewerbung@berlinerstadtgueter.de. Förderung einer ökologischen und nachhaltigen Landwirtschaft Wir fordern und fördern eine ressourcenschonende, umwelt- und tiergerechte Landwirtschaft . Sowohl im Stall, als auch auf dem Feld oder in der Energieversorgung streben wir, angelehnt an die Prinzipien der Permakultur, einen möglichst geschlossenen Nährstoffkreislauf, eine vielfältige Fruchtfolge sowie tiergerechte Haltungsverfahren an. Im Fokus unserer Geschäftstätigkeit stehen die Vermietung und Verpachtung unserer Flächen und Liegenschaften sowie der Schutz natürlicher Ressourcen. Ziel ist der Erhalt und die nachhaltige Entwicklung des ländlichen Raums im Berliner Umland. Zukunftsweisende Geschäftsfelder, wie z. B. das der Kompensationsmaßnahmen im Natur- und Artenschutz, entwickeln wir gezielt weiter. 

Die Berliner Stadtgüter GmbH sind Anbieter von Ausgleichs- und Ersatzmaßnahmen, die wir auf unseren Eigentumsflächen im Auftrag von kompensationspflichtigen Bauträger:innen planen, herstellen und dauerhaft pflegen. 

Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams im Bereich Natur und Umwelt möchten wir ab sofort in Voll- oder Teilzeit folgende Stelle unbefristet besetzen:

Vertragsmanagement und -controlling Landschaftsplanung (gn)

Aufgaben
  • Vermarktung von Kompensationsmaßnahmen des Natur-, Wald-, und Artenschutzes: Erstellen von vorhabenspezifischen Verträgen über Flächenreservierung/ -bereitstellung, Herstellung und dauerhafte Pflege und Sicherung von Maßnahmen und Mitwirkung an den Vertragsverhandlungen; Kundenbetreuung, Übergabe an die Bauleitung
  • Organisation und Durchführung der Datenerfassung und -pflege zu Kompensationsverträgen sowie -maßnahmen, Rechnungslegung, kaufmännische Verwaltung und Controlling der Maßnahmen und Abrechnung, Schnittstelle zum kaufmännischen Bereich sowie zur Projektleitung Landschaftsplanung
  • Beauftragung von produktionsintegrierten Kompensationsmaßnahmen: Erstellen und Verwalten von Bewirtschaftungsverträgen, Abrechnung 
  • Unterstützung bei der Angebotserstellung und Kalkulation der langjährigen Kompensationsleistungen
  • Mitwirkung an der Wirtschaftsplanung für den Bereich Natur und Umwelt
  • Darstellung der Maßnahmen und Verträge im Geographischen Informationssystem und Datenpflege
  • Verantwortung für fachspezifische Software sowie ggf. die relevanten Module und Funktionen im ERP-System, einschl. der korrekten Abbildung der Geschäftsprozesse des eigenen Aufgabenbereichs sowie deren Abstimmung mit Schnittstellen anderer Bereiche 
  • Mitwirkung an Projektarbeiten des Unternehmens zur Prozessoptimierung für den eigenen Fachbereich oder auch in übergreifenden Projekten, an denen der Fachbereich beteiligt ist
  • Wahrnehmung von externen Kontakten zu Geschäftspartnern, Ämtern, Behörden und Kunden
  • Flächenakquisition zum weiteren Ausbau des Geschäftsfeldes der Kompensationsmaßnahmen
Anforderungen
  • Interesse an Naturschutz und Landschaftsgestaltung
  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium an einer (Fach-)Hochschule im Bereich der Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Nachhaltigkeitsmanagement oder vergleichbaren Studiengängen mit betriebswirtschaftlicher Ausrichtung
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrungen in den oben genannten Aufgabenbereichen 
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau nach dem Gemeinsamen europäischen Referenzrahmen für Sprachen (GeR)
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrungen in der Anwendung von Geografischen Informationssystemen 
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Excel sowie vertiefte Kenntnisse in der Arbeit mit SAP oder anderen ERP-Systemen
  • Digitalaffin, veränderungsbereit, Freude an der Gestaltung strukturierter und effizienter Prozesse
  • Kfz-Führerschein
Benefits
  • Mitarbeit in einem motivierten, engagierten Team mit echter Freude an Zusammenarbeit und eine gründliche Einarbeitung mit kurzen und schnellen Kommunikationswegen und Absprachen
  • Vergütung nach Haustarifvertrag in der Gehaltsgruppe 5; die GG 5 umfasst eine Entgeltspanne beim Grundgehalt von 36.600,00 Euro bis 62.400,00 Euro brutto jährlich, abhängig von relevanter Berufserfahrung, Verantwortungsumfang, Fachkenntnissen und Fähigkeiten 
  • Weihnachts- und Urlaubsgeld, vermögenswirksame Leistungen und betriebliche Altersvorsorge, 30 Tage Urlaub sowie am 24. und 31.12. dienstfrei
  • Gleitende Arbeitszeit und Telearbeit (mit der dafür benötigten technischen Ausstattung), u.a. zur verbesserten Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf
  • Einen barrierearmen Zugang und Möglichkeiten zur individuellen Gestaltung des Büros bei Bedarf
  • Zentral gelegenes Büro mit guter Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr sowie Fahrradboxen zum Verschließen der Räder
  • Regelmäßige Fort- und Weiterbildungsangebote
  • Zuschüsse zum BVG Deutschlandticket Job, zum (E-)Bike-Leasing über Eurorad und zum Firmenfitness bei Urban Sports 
Bewerbungsprozess

Wir haben Ihr Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre aussagekräftige Bewerbung. Wir begrüßen eine Bewerbung ohne Foto. 

Wir akzeptieren laufend Bewerbungen und streben an, die Stelle zum 01.09.2026 zu besetzen. 

Wir befinden uns in einem fortlaufenden Prozess des Kulturwandels und zu mehr Diversität und wünschen uns auch Bewerbungen von Menschen, die von struktureller Diskriminierung betroffen sind oder sein könnten.

Anerkannte Schwerbehinderte und ihnen gleichgestellte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Bitte weisen Sie auf eine Schwerbehinderung gegebenenfalls bereits in der Bewerbung hin.

{"@context":"https://schema.org/","@type":"JobPosting","title":"Stakeholder Engagement Support","description":"

Contract Type: Consultancy

Contract Duration: From Mid August 2026 to 30 November 2026

Deadline to Submit a Candidacy: 7 August 2026, 11:59 PM CEST

CGIAR is seeking an experienced individual consultant or firm (hereafter “Consultant”) to provide targeted and time-bound coordination and facilitation support on stakeholder engagement as part of the development of CGIAR’s 2040 Strategy. The Consultant will work under the oversight of the CGIAR Strategy Task Team and its Work Stream 5 on Stakeholder Engagement to ensure strong stakeholder ownership of, commitment to, and support for the Strategy.

Background and context

CGIAR has embarked on a process to develop a comprehensive Strategy to 2040. Guided by the overarching question: “What do we want CGIAR to become?”; the proposed CGIAR Strategy drives clarity and alignment on CGIAR’s mission, vision, and strategic priorities to the year 2040. The Strategy aims to reposition CGIAR for greater relevance, effectiveness, and impact in a changing global context; and articulate CGIAR’s forward-looking value proposition and comparative advantage. The CGIAR Strategy is developed under the oversight of the CGIAR Board, the leadership of the CGIAR Executive Managing Director, and the guidance of CGIAR’s partnership-wide Global Leadership Team (GLT). A CGIAR Strategy Task Team, comprising representatives of all CGIAR Centers and the CGIAR System Organization, is responsible for the development of the Strategy through a transparent and inclusive co-design process.

In support of its Work Stream 5 on Stakeholder Engagement, the CGIAR Strategy Task Team seeks the Consultant to contribute towards an inclusive identification of stakeholder priorities, expectations, and perceptions; a deeper understanding of CGIAR’s real and perceived strategic positioning and comparative advantage; areas of convergence and divergence across different stakeholders and stakeholder groups; and a preliminary identification of continent- and region-specific interests that can inform future regional/continental strategies to operationalize the overarching CGIAR 2040 Strategy.

\n

Requirements

Scope of Work

Working under the oversight and guidance of the CGIAR Strategy Task Team and its Work Stream 5 on Stakeholder Engagement, the Consultant will:

• Stakeholder engagement planning: refine the Task Team’s stakeholder engagement plan, including stakeholder mapping and engagement methods.

• Stakeholder survey: design, implement, and analyze and summarize the results of a broad-based stakeholder survey in support of the CGIAR Strategy.

• Key stakeholder interviews: conduct 50–60 semi-structured key stakeholder interviews (CGIAR leadership, Board members, Council members, partners) and analyze and summarize relevant insights.

• Consultation meetings: organize, facilitate, and capture the outcomes of targeted virtual and in-person stakeholder meetings.

• Final report: across the key responsibilities above, prepare a final report that translates findings into actionable, strategic insights as an input to the Task Team’s Synthesis Report (by early October 2026).

Deliverables

• Refined stakeholder engagement plan, including stakeholder mapping and engagement methods.

• Stakeholder survey instrument, implementation, and analysis with summary of results.

• Summary of key insights from 50–60 semi-structured stakeholder interviews.

• Outcomes of targeted virtual and in-person consultation meetings.

• Final report translating findings into actionable, strategic insights as an input to the Task Team’s Synthesis Report (by early October 2026).

Timeline

The process to develop the CGIAR Strategy to 2040 is set out in the following broad phases:

• June–early November 2026: analytical work and stakeholder engagement culminating in a Synthesis Report by the Strategy Task Team and broad-based Stakeholder Workshop in early November.

• November 2026–January 2027: stakeholder review and iteration of a complete draft Strategy.

• January–February 2027: CGIAR Leadership and governance-level reviews and decision-making on an intended final version of the Strategy.

• March 2027: Launch, roll-out.

Consultant Profile

The Consultant will demonstrate strong experience and expertise in the following areas:

• Multistakeholder engagement design, planning, and delivery in an international science, innovation, and/or development setting.

• Convening and facilitation.

• Quantitative and qualitative survey design and analysis.

• Strategic communication and diplomacy.

• Strategy design and development.

A deep understanding of and familiarity with CGIAR’s stakeholder environment and work on science and innovations to transform food, land, and water systems is desirable.

Evaluation Criteria

• Quality and relevance of experience and expertise.

• Value for money.

• Ability to deliver within the proposed timeline.

To Submit a Proposal

Candidates will submit:

• A short profile (for individuals) or company profile (for firms) demonstrating relevant experience and qualifications.

• A concise technical proposal outlining approach and delivery steps within the proposed timeframe.

• A simple budget proposal outlining the proposed number of working days and the Consultant’s daily rate, with costs broken down by deliverable.

\n

Benefits

All applications must be submitted online by clicking the 'Apply' button below before 11:59 PM CET on 07 August 2026.

If you require assistance or face challenges in submitting your application, please email smo-bidding@cgiar.org with the position title in the subject line. Applications submitted through smo-bidding@cgiar.org will NOT be accepted.

Please ensure your resume and cover letter are in English and does not contain your marital status, age, or photograph. Documents provided in a language other than English will not be considered.

CGIAR is committed to fair, safe, and inclusive workplaces. We believe that diversity powers our innovation, contributes to our excellence, and is critical for our mission. We offer a multi-cultural, multi-color, multi-generational, and multi-disciplinary, collegial working environment. We consciously create an inclusive organization that reflects our global character and commitment to gender equity. We, therefore, encourage applicants from all cultures, races, ethnicities, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientations, and gender identities.

content.Title: Employed worker in Greece - Migration and Home Affairs
content.MainContent: Page contents Page contents Conditions To work in Greece as an employed worker, you need:a national visa for employment;a residence permit for employment.According to the new Migration Code, Greece implements a system of volumes of admission of non-EU nationals for the purposes of dependent/salaried employment, which are included in a joint ministerial decision issued every two years setting the maximum number of jobs for salaried employment by region and specialty jobs. For this decision to be issued, the opinions of competent bodies (Economic and Social Council of Greece, Greek Manpower Employment Organisation, the Regions of the country), with regard to the current employment needs in the Greek territory, are taken into consideration. These needs are defined mainly according to the following criteria: consultation between the regional authorities and employer agencies, the interest of national economy, the feasibility of the employment, the labour offer by Greek nationals, citizens of the European Union or legally residing in Greece non-EU nationals per specialty and the percentages of unemployment per section of employment.On the basis of this maximum number, employers who wish to employ salaried staff should apply to the Decentralized Administration of their place of residence, submitting also i) a valid work contract of at least one year, where it is clearly mentioned that the monthly remuneration of the person to be employed will amount to at least that of an unskilled worker and ii) a tax certificate where it is evidenced that the employer can actually pay this remuneration. The Secretary General of the Decentralized Administration can only approve the employment of non-EU citizens by the specific employee, if the specialization in question is included in the aforementioned joint ministerial decision and the number allowed has not been covered already. This approval is being sent to the consular authority where the employees concerned are informed to present themselves in order to sign the employment contract and receive their visa to enter the country. Procedures Where and how to applyVisaYou must apply for a visa at the embassy or consulate in your country of origin. [see Invitation Procedure above in “Conditions”]Residence permitUpon arrival, and before your visa expires, you must apply for a residence permit as an employed worker. All applications for residence permits are submitted at the one-stop-shops of the Decentralized Administration. When you apply, and if all the necessary documents are submitted, you are issued a certificate which is valid for one year and during its validity you reside legally in the country. If your application is still pending after one year, a new certificate will be issued and you will be informed on the reasons of the delay.The competent Department of the Decentralized Administration examines your application and issues a residence permit valid for two years.Documents requiredTo apply for a visa, you need a number of documents (such as your passport, a signed copy of the employment contract, and a copy of your criminal record) that are set in a Decision by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Because of the new Code for Migration and Social Integration (Law 4251/2014), also an approval decision on the employment of the non-EU citizen by a specific employee issued by the Decentralized Admisistration is required for the issuance of the requisite visa. .To apply for an initial residence permit, you need:a copy of your passport and visa;photographs;a fee of €300;your employment contract; anda certificate that you have applied to the relevant insurance agency for full health insurance.Duration of validity of permitsResidence permits to work as an employed worker are valid for two years and can be renewed for three years. Applications for renewal should be submitted two months before the permit expires. Late applications for the renewal of residence permits may be submitted up to one month after the expiry; in such case, the non-EU citizen is subject to a fine of € 50. Applications for renewal of residence permits for employed workers are submitted to the Decentralized Administration of the applicant’s place of residence, accompanied by all supporting documents and the set fee.AppealsAppeals against reasoned decisions may be lodged to the administrative court, as well as to the administrative authority that originally issued the decision.Further informationN/A Rights Non-EU citizens legally residing in the country enjoy the following rights:Free movement and settlement across the country. Their residence or establishment may be prohibited, for reasons of public interest, in certain geographic areas of the country.Access to social security organizations and insurance rights.Access to social protection.The validity of residence permits is not affected by temporary absence from the country of maximum of six months per year, or other absence for a specific reason such as military service, pregnancy, health issues, or professional training.In case of minors, access to compulsory education.Recognition of primary and secondary education acquired in the home country, according to decision by the Ministry of Education.Access to universities provided they have attended high school in Greece.Exercise of any professional activity, provided all requirements of the law are met, without submitting a reciprocity certificate.Non-EU citizens who are detained receive, as soon as they are detained, information regarding their rights and obligations, as well as services they can access. This information is provided in in a language they can understand. The communication is facilitated by consular or diplomatic members of staff of their state of citizenship or origin, as well as through authorized lawyers.Actions that cause or provoke acts of discrimination, hatred or violence, or constitute an insult against persons on the grounds of their ethnic or national origin, religion or other beliefs, disability, age or sexual orientation, is automatically prosecuted.UnemploymentNon-EU citizens legally residing in Greece are insured at competent social security organizations and enjoy the same social security rights as Greeks.To renew your residence permit, no employment contract is necessary, but you need to have fulfilled your tax obligations, to have a minimum number of wages at the relevant insurance organization and to have a valid health insurance certificate.Change of employmentYou can sign an employment contract with another employer during the validity of the initial residence permit under the condition that this does not affect the professional specialization for which this permit was issued or the social security organization in which you are insured.You can work in another Regional unit one year after the issuance of the initial residence permit. This is also the case for change of professional specialization withing the dependent employment status.Long-term residence Long-term resident permitIf you have resided in Greece lawfully and continuously for five years before submitting your application, you can apply for a long-term resident permit provided that:you have your own income for the sustenance of your family, which cannot be lower than the annual minimum wage, increased by 10% for all dependent members of your family, including any unemployment benefit received. The contributions of the family members are taken into consideration for the calculation of the income;you have full social security for yourself and the members of your family;you fulfill the requirements for integration into Greek society, that is, you have:evidence of adequate knowledge of the Greek language and elements of Greek history and culture, as defined in national legislation; ora residence Card as member of the family of a Greek citizen; ora positive opinion by a Citizenship Committee; oryou have legally resided in Greece for twelve years.You will still be able to apply for this status if you have been absent from Greece for less than six consecutive months and/or 10 months during this five-year period.You must submit your application to the authority that issued your last/previous residence permit, and meet all necessary conditions. The decision should be issued within six months, which can be delayed for an additional three month period.The long-term resident permit is valid for five years and is renewable for five years.A long-term resident enjoys equal treatment with Greek citizens in the following:access to salaried employment and non salaried work, terms of employment, remuneration and dismissal;access to education and professional training;recognition of vocational degrees, certificates and other documents;social security and basic social protection;tax relief;access to public goods and services housing procedures;free movement and settlement in the territory. content.Title: What if it all goes right? - by Anne Marie Kingsland
content.MainContent: What if it all goes right?We bet our company on AI. Here’s the case for optimism.Anne Marie KingslandJun 29, 20267ShareIn 2022, Intercom (now Fin) faced a reckoning. Five consecutive quarters of declining revenue growth required serious action. Our founding CEO Eoghan returned with a five-point plan, we refocused our efforts around a single product category, and underwent a reduction in force. And then, ChatGPT arrived. Our co-founder Des Traynor wondered if the emergence of AI was “adding insult to injury, or the single scenario that we can’t survive?”All around us, SaaS companies were getting “sold off for parts to private equity.” The end seemed near.But after a weekend of experimenting with the newly released LLM, the future appeared less bleak than initially forecast. As Des put it: “AI might actually be both the death of our company and also the best chance we have of survival.”By Monday, we decided to go all in, and over the next three years we rebuilt almost everything we’d spent the previous eleven years building, including the name.Des recently talked through how that happened – on The Further, Faster Podcast and the AI Revolution Show. What follows pulls the two conversations together: the entrepreneurial lessons learned along the way, what to consider when undergoing your own AI pivot, and why Des thinks we’ve grown too pessimistic about the AI-powered future.Focus on the product in front of youBefore the AI story, there’s the unglamorous part that made it possible. On The Further, Faster Podcast, Des walks us through it and what he thinks today’s entrepreneurs should focus on.Firstly, the job of a founder is “to do something that doesn’t make sense up until the point that it does make sense” – and the moment it makes sense, the founder phase is over and you’re running a business. Des feels it’s not good to idolize or obsess over the label of founder because it should be a temporary role; don’t cling to it rather than admitting your company has stopped working. The entrepreneurs he’d back again are the ones who “closed their business down, gave the money back, took a couple of years working in a good company, got some new ideas, and went again.”That’s also why he’s wary of early-stage companies chasing investment capital. “A really long runway is not what you should be optimizing for. You should be optimizing for success.” Chase the valuation and you end up watching your own stock price instead of asking the only questions that matter: “are we building good software? Do people like it? Are they paying a good amount of money for it?”You can feel the difference in the products themselves. Des refers to the experience of building Exceptional – an error-tracking tool the team developed before Intercom – as “doing your best to try and push it up a hill”. Intercom was the opposite: it “was a very easy product to bring out,” viral in the way B2B occasionally is. Early users routinely praised it, even just a few months in.This is why it’s important to ship. Founders often delay launching because they’re afraid to find out their product doesn’t work, and a reputation as a “considerate, tasteful founder” is a comfortable disguise for that fear. After you ship, take user feedback seriously but not blindly. When they ask for 11 more features, don’t assume they’re right – “that could be their way of saying this is a bag of shit.”Becoming an AI company takes sacrificeThe decision to go all in on AI was, oddly, the easy part. It was clear, customer service was about to be changed completely, and it was a race against the clock to be the first to market.The hard part was everything after the decision. A transformation like this touches the whole company – the branding, the pricing, what you sell, how you build, and who you compete with. On the AI Revolution Show, Des compares it to the ship of Theseus: change enough of the parts and it’s hard to say what’s still the original boat. “Maybe the canteen is the same,” he joked.What made that survivable was culture set deliberately, in advance. When Eoghan returned and rewrote the company values, three of them – resilience, open-mindedness, and impatience – read, in hindsight, like preparation for exactly this. So when we made radical decisions like breaking up teams or abandoning roadmaps, the ground had already been laid.For companies going through change, Des also warns not to “be a prisoner of nostalgia.” Intercom was a longstanding, beloved brand. On the surface, sacrificing it looks like a significant risk. But he argues the opposite. “Being known isn’t always useful – it can almost be a counterweight.”He tested this theory with a thought experiment: “If I said the coolest new payroll app is built by Workday, you’d be like, really?” The name you’ve spent a decade building can be the very thing that stops people believing you’re building something new, so you have to be willing to “shred and shed that brand legacy.”Building and selling the AI-native wayPlenty of products call themselves AI-native. Most fail the first test: does the product work? Customer support is load-bearing – if it breaks, the business breaks – so “it works most of the time” isn’t good enough.Clearing that bar takes more than a wrapper. We’ve gone down to the model layer with Apex, and what looks from the outside like a single product is, in Des’s words, “more like 27 systems connected together,” several revisions deep.Looks can be deceiving though. It’s common for users to think they can recreate Fin with a frontier model, and maybe they can reach a 30 or 40% resolution rate in two minutes. “The other forty percent is going to take you three years and 60 people.” We watch prospects try to build their own, get stuck, and come back – and sometimes the only useful thing is to let them “bang their head off a brick wall” and leave the door open.Building for AI is different from building software. We used to start with customer research, but because customers aren’t experts in what AI now makes possible, you now have to start with what’s technically reliable and take that to the market. It’s a reversal Des expects to be temporary, until the technology settles.You also have to rethink design. The AI-native instinct isn’t to begin with “boxes and arrows and buttons.” It’s to take the least amount from the user and give back the most. The example Des provides is bug reporting. Rather than relying on users to report issues, a bug should be automatically detected so the experience goes “from seven screens to no screens.”And the impact of all of this must be easily demonstrable. According to Des: “brand will get you the demand, but ultimately performance is what gets you the contract.” Serious buyers run bake-offs – a thousand of their own real questions across three vendors – and we lean into it. Rigour favours whoever is actually best; deliver results and the sales will follow.What if it all goes right?AI is going to keep moving. It’s a realization Des has had to come to terms with: “I’ve probably been more wrong than right whenever I’ve said … I think the AI is settled here.”What does this pace of advancement mean for the wider market? The walls between products will come down – point solutions will be absorbed by whoever owns the rest of the workflow. Des thinks the systems of record will endure, and a smaller number of larger businesses will dominate.It’s reasonable to feel apprehension towards such a mammoth change, it’s a narrative that dominates the media. And overall, the conversation about AI has become fluent in every way it might go wrong. But we’re strangely quiet about the other possibility. “No one’s asking what if it all goes right,” Des says – what it might mean for things like education or healthcare access.The near term will hold real dislocation, and we’re not pretending otherwise. But the upside, he argues, “is potentially the biggest thing we’re ever going to see for humanity.”We’ve already run the small version of that experiment on ourselves. We bet the company, disrupted the thing we’d built, and came out the other side stronger for it. That isn’t proof the larger bet pays off. But it’s reason enough to take the optimistic question seriously – and to keep building as though the answer is yes.Watch or listen to the full conversations: Des Traynor on The Further, Faster Podcast and the AI Revolution Show.7SharePreviousNextDiscussion about this postCommentsRestacksTopLatestDiscussionsNo postsReady for more?Subscribe

content.Title: Recruit Smarter: Success Strategies for the Financial World - Gi Group Ireland
content.MainContent: Home/B2B/Recruit Smarter: Success Strategies for the Financial WorldBack to News & Blogs23 October 2024Recruit Smarter: Success Strategies for the Financial WorldThe financial services industry is one of the most dynamic sectors when it comes to recruitment. Whether it’s banking, insurance, FinTech, or capital markets, attracting the right talent is critical but often comes with a unique set of challenges. Stringent compliance requirements, high competition for specialised jobs, and the pressure to hire quickly can make it difficult to build the right team. But with the correct strategies in place, it’s possible to turn these challenges into opportunities for growth and success. In this blog, we’ll explore the top recruitment hurdles in the financial services industry and share how Gi Group Holding has helped organisations like iPSL overcome them. Common Recruitment Challenges in Financial Services Recruiting for roles in the financial services sector isn’t always straightforward. Here are some of the most common obstacles business face: Compliance Requirements: Hiring in the financial sector often means navigating a web of compliance checks, from credit checks to anti-money laundering verifications. These processes can be time-consuming, which means that securing the right candidate can take longer than expected. Top Talent Competition: As digital transformation accelerates in banking and FinTech, the competition for specialised skills has intensified. This makes it more challenging to attract and retain the right professionals, especially when competing against other firms with deep pockets. Pressure to Reduce Time-to-Hire: In such a fast-paced environment, hiring managers often face the pressure of meeting tight timelines. Yet, rushing the process can mean missing out on qualified candidates or ending up with hires that don’t quite fit the role. The stakes are high, but the rewards of getting recruitment right are even higher. That’s why it’s essential to have a strategic approach tailored to the unique needs of the financial services industry. Gi Group Holding’s Approach to Overcoming Recruitment Obstacles At Gi Group Holding, we’ve built our expertise in navigating the complexities of recruitment in the financial services sector. Here’s how we address these key challenges: Streamlining Compliance and Vetting: We work closely with specialised third-party providers to ensure that background checks and compliance verifications are completed quickly and accurately. This means you get the peace of mind you need without unnecessary delays in your hiring process. Targeted Talent Attraction Strategies: Through our targeted attraction campaigns, we reach both active and passive candidates who are the best fit for your roles. We focus on building a pool of candidates with the specific skills and experience that matter most to you, ensuring that you always have access to top-tier talent. Enhancing Candidate Engagement: Long and complex recruitment processes can sometimes cause candidate drop-off, especially in highly regulated sectors. That’s why we place a strong emphasis on maintaining a high level of engagement throughout the recruitment journey, keeping candidates interested and informed. A Success Story—Partnering with iPSL Wondering how these strategies work in practice? Let’s look at our long-standing partnership with iPSL, a leader in the financial services sector. They faced a range of challenges, from meeting tight timelines for hiring IT contractors to maintaining a steady supply of skilled professionals in a highly competitive market.With Gi Group Holding’s support, iPSL was able to enhance their recruitment processes, ensuring a rapid response to their needs while maintaining high standards for candidate quality. Our collaborative efforts allowed them to meet their recruitment goals efficiently and establish a robust pipeline of talent. Read the full case study Conclusion: Recruiting in the financial services industry doesn’t have to be a struggle. With the right partner, you can navigate complex compliance requirements, attract top talent, and reduce time-to-hire. At Gi Group Holding, we bring the experience and expertise needed to help you build a team that drives success. Want to learn more about how we can transform your recruitment process? About Turing

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world's leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L

Role Overview

The Common Lives Project is a pioneering initiative aimed at collecting rich, real-world data to better understand human daily routines for the development of next-generation AI systems. This will involve households recording their daily activities using wearable GoPro devices. The footage will inform research into AI perception, activity recognition, and social context understanding.

Responsibilities

  • Wear a head-mounted GoPro camera to capture daily activities for 5 separate days within a 2-week window
  • Record a minimum of 7 hours per day, with flexibility to take breaks and pause the camera for privacy
  • At the end of each day, spend around 2 hours to:
  • Upload your footage to a secure platform
  • Review short clips
  • Choose to delete, anonymize, or consent to each video segment

Household Requirements:

  • No children (under 18) present or visiting during the recording period
  • All adults in the space must be fluent English speakers and consent to being recorded
  • Must live in a private, self-contained apartment, building, or indoor work environment
  • All household members must agree to appear in the footage

Participant Requirements:

  • Must work indoors in non-customer-facing roles (e.g., not retail or child care)
  • Participants who share the same workplace or household should both have a GoPro mounted during the activity.
  • Preferably engaged in manual or creative work (e.g., chef, baker, artist, carpenter, musician, electrician, mechanic)
  • Must be self-employed or have employer consent to record in the work environment
  • Able to use a computer for basic tasks such as reviewing and uploading video clips

Technical Requirements:

  • Must have access to a computer and internet connection
  • Comfortable using web-based tools for uploading and reviewing clips (training will be provided)
  • GoPro camera and all accessories will be provided for the duration of the project

Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Play a vital role in shaping the future of human-centered AI research
  • Short-term, flexible engagement with minimal disruption to your routine
  • All equipment provided by Turing
  • Be part of an innovative global data collection initiative

Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 5 recording days within a 2-week window
  • Engagement Type: Contractor / Freelance
  • Duration: 2 weeks (plus setup and review time)
  • Location: India, Brazil, Colombia

Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a brief screening
  • Once accepted, Turing will ship all necessary equipment and provide onboarding instructions
  • Participants will receive training on how to record, upload, and review their footage securely

content.Title: Praktikum Event- und Ausstellungsorganisation – IPAI Foundation (m/w/d) – IPAI Foundation
content.MainContent: Praktikum Event- und Ausstellungsorganisation – IPAI Foundation (m/w/d) Heilbronn Hybrid Vollzeit We look forward to receiving your application! Go to application portal Jetzt zum Bewerbungsportal Du möchtest dich mit gesellschaftlichen und technologischen Fragestellungen rund um das Thema menschenzentrierte KI beschäftigen?Die IPAI Foundation agiert als Brückenbauerin zwischen Forschung, Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft und ergänzt die wirtschaftlichen Aktivitäten von IPAI.Unsere Mission: Wir wollen Menschen befähigen, Künstliche Intelligenz zu verstehen, verantwortungsvoll zu gestalten und aktiv am gesellschaftlichen Diskurs teilzunehmen. Dafür schaffen wir Programme, Formate und Orte für einen wertvollen Austausch.Wir im Team AI Literacy & Engagement sind Teil der IPAI Foundation und dafür verantwortlich KI auf unterschiedliche Weise erlebbar zu machen und den Zugang zu Wissen rund um KI zu ermöglichen. Dies leisten wir zum einen durch Ausstellungen in unserem IPAI LIVING ROOM, dem Besucherzentrum in den IPAI SPACES. Wir vermitteln KI-Wissen auch durch Veranstaltungsformate wie den KI Salon, das KI Festival und weitere Programme rund um AI Literacy. Unser größtes Anliegen ist es, über KI aufzuklären, Diskussionen anzuregen, KI-Wissen für alle Gesellschaftsschichten zugänglich zu machen, aber auch für KI-Technologie zu begeistern. Deine Aufgaben Unterstütze uns dabei, vielfältige Inhalte zu organisieren und Veranstaltungen auf die Beine zu stellenHilf uns tatkräftig bei der Organisation und Koordination des KI Festivals im VorfeldUnterstütze operativ bei Veranstaltungen, unserer Webseite und Social Media-Beiträgen des KI SalonsKoordiniere gemeinsam mit dem Team Ausstellungswechsel und Veranstaltungen in unserem IPAI LIVING ROOM und mache KI durch Exponate und Demonstratoren erlebbar und vermittle unsere Inhalte adiverse Zielgruppen; das bedeutet im Detail für dein Praktikum:Führe umfangreiche Recherchen zu Inhalten im Besucherzentrum und Trendthemen an der Schnittstelle von KI, Kunst und Bildung durch und pflege unsere DatenbankenÜbernimm die Kommunikation mit Partnern und GewerkenUnterstütze die logistische Organisation von Ausstellungswechseln, Vorträgen, Lesungen etc. zusammen mit unserem TeamHilf uns, unsere Bibliothek und Podcast-Station im LIVING ROOM up to date zu halten Dein Profil Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d) mit einem geisteswissenschaftlichen, wirtschaftswissenschaftlichen oder designnahen Profil, z.B. Kunstgeschichte, Graphik-Design, Kulturmanagement, Betriebswirtschaft; wir sind auch offen für thematische Quereinsteiger, wenn du für unsere Themen brennstDu experimentierst gerne mit KI-Tools wie ChatGPT und hast Interesse, dich in weitere KI-Tools einzuarbeitenDu interessierst dich für Ausstellungen, z.B. in Museen, Science Centern oder Besucherzentren und bist neugierig, wie man diese koordiniertDich begeistern interaktive Exponate und das Interesse für Events, Kultur, Bildung und KI im Allgemeinen machen dich ausDu bist kommunikativ, kreativ und arbeitest gerne im Team Du bringst Eigeninitiative und Spaß an der Vermittlung mitDeine sehr guten Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab Unser Angebot Hinter IPAI steht die Vision, das „Global Home of Human AI“ zu werden – ein Anspruch, der in der IPAI Foundation auf gesellschaftliche Verantwortung und Gestaltungswillen trifft. Dich erwartet ein Umfeld, in dem Pioneering Spirit gelebt wird: Du hast den Freiraum, Neues zu erschaffen und das Wachstum der IPAI Foundation aktiv mitzugestalten. Dabei bist du Teil einer lebendigen Innovationsplattform, die den Dialog zwischen Wissenschaft, Wirtschaft, öffentliche Hand und Gesellschaft aktiv moderiert. Wenn du Lust hast, in einem starken Miteinander und einem ambitionierten Team diese Vision Wirklichkeit werden zu lassen, passt du zu uns.Dein Arbeitsalltag – deine Flexibilität Innovation braucht Freiheit statt fester Zeiten. Bei uns entscheidest du, wo und wann dein Impact am größten ist: Ob Deep Work im Homeoffice oder Co-Creation vor Ort, ob Early Bird oder Night Owl – wir verzichten auf starre 9-to-5-Strukturen. Was bei uns zählt, ist nicht die reine Anwesenheit, sondern das Ergebnis.Dein persönliches WachstumDeine Lernkurve ist bei uns steil. Wir begleiten deine Entwicklung individuell und unterstützen dich durch maßgeschneiderte Weiterbildungen und gezieltes Sparring.Unser Teamgeist und ArbeitsatmosphäreKomm wie du bist: Bei uns zählt dein authentisches Ich und eine gelebte Du-Kultur auf Augenhöhe. Du arbeitest in einer inspirierenden Umgebung in unserem hochmodernen Office, in dem es dir an nichts fehlt. Innovation braucht Austausch, wir stärken deshalb unseren Zusammenhalt durch regelmäßige Teamevents und legendäre Offsites.Unser InnovationsökosystemBei IPAI bist du Teil eines einzigartigen Netzwerks aus Startups, Unternehmen und der Forschung. Du hast direkten Zugriff auf exklusives ExpertInnenwissen und Inspiration durch hochkarätige Keynotes sowie Tech-Impulse. Vernetze dich auf unseren Events mit den klügsten Köpfen und gestalte als aktiver Teil der Community das Global Home of Human AI mit.Deine VergütungWir bieten dir ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket und attraktive Vorsorgemodelle.Deine zusätzlichen BenefitsProfitiere vom umfassenden Benefit-Netzwerk der Unternehmen der Schwarz Gruppe: zum Beispiel den freien Zugang zu unseren modernen Fitnessstudios, das Medical-Center mit fachärztlicher Versorgung oder Corporate Benefits. content.Title: Science Residency – IPAI Foundation
content.MainContent: THE IPAI Science Residency The AI Fellowship enabling impact The IPAI Science Residency is a one-year research program which is designed to support bold ideas and personal growth in a dynamic, collaborative environment. your fellowship - Your vision - your home of ai - your fellowship - Your vision - your home of ai - your fellowship - Your vision - your home of ai - your fellowship - Your vision - your home of ai - your fellowship - Your vision - your home of ai - your fellowship - Your vision - your home of ai - your fellowship - Your vision - your home of ai - your fellowship - Your vision - your home of ai - your fellowship - Your vision - your home of ai - your fellowship - Your vision - your home of ai - your fellowship - Your vision - your home of ai - your fellowship - Your vision - your home of ai - Theprogram Employed by the non-profit IPAI Foundation, residents lead their own research project with a clear path to application, without compromising their academic freedom.The program is most suitable for fellows who have already advanced their research. The fellowship provides six-figure funding, access to cutting-edge infrastructure, tailored support, and the opportunity to become part of the vibrant IPAI community – a network shaping the future of AI across science, industry, policy, and society. The residency provides a space where scientific excellence connects with societal relevance. WHO IS THE PROGRAM FOR? The residency is designed for scientists who have already advanced their research and aim to shape the future of AIacross domains. Motivation Seeking to turn their research into real-world impactCurious to explore new pathways between academia and applicationAiming to shape the future of AI beyond disciplinary boundariesCommitted to concluding their residency with a research paper that is accessible to the general publicReady to engage with the vibrant IPAI ecosystem in Heilbronn to connect with top minds from different sectorsThe commitment to conclude their residency with a set of outcomes that translate their research into practice - including a publicly accessible research paper that records its key research findings and shares them with a broader audience Experience A PhD or at least three years of research experience in the field of AIA strong track record in AI-related research – whether in computer science, engineering, life sciences, social sciences, psychology, or related disciplines What makes this residency unique? You define your research topic, we provide the structure. Your Project, Your Vision.We provide the structureSecure Framework. A full-time employment for the duration of the program, featuring an attractive salary and a six-figure research budget.Societal Impact at the Core.Whether it’s a product or a prototype – we support research that makes a difference.Individual Support.Mentoring, coaching, and strategic guidance tailored to your needs.Meaningful Connections.Collaborate with leading AI experts, industry partners, policy makers and the IPAI community in Heilbronn. The Package Customize your residency experience with a predefined budget tailored to your needs. Design your benefits by choosing mentorship options, acquiring technical equipment, and more. 01 Financial Support Focus fully on your research with an attractive salary, a generous budget, and targeted grants for relocation and personal expenses.Fixed-term employment with an attractive salary commensurate with a highly-qualified postdoctoral position in Germany. Read moreA six-figure research budget for infrastructure, travel, conferences, prototyping, etc.Discretionary funds for relocation, family moves, or visa costs 02 Mentoring & Coaching Get personalized guidance for project growth, leadership training, and business development – tailored to your personal goals and challenges.Startup Preparation & Business Model DevelopmentInvestor & Founder NetworkLegal & IP InformationAcademic MentoringCareer & Leadership Coaching, Methods TrainingResearch Publication & CommercializationResearch Transfer & Innovation 03 Local Settlement Make use of our smooth transition support to Heilbronn with help on administration, visas, and social integration settling into everyday life to build your social networks.Relocation SupportVisa and Administrative AssistanceWelcome Program 04 Tech Expertise Not only receive financial and structural support but direct access to leading experts and cutting-edge AI tools and technologies.Advice and exchange on technical topicsHands-on labs & access to tech stacks 05 Community Join a diverse ecosystem connecting more than 60 members and partners across various fields in academia, industry, and policy.IPAI Foundation NetworkUser Circles on LLM/RAG, Agents, Data and MLOpsInterdisciplinary Collaboration & Exchange ProgramsExclusive Events & Collaboration FormatsLong-Term Alumni Network 06 Infrastructure Work in a modern environment with access to high-performance computing and specialized laboratories to advance your research in the best way possible.Co-working space in the IPAI SPACESCompute power and AI infrastructure such as the IPAI Playground, GPU-Power, AI-Gadgets and DataLaboratories and test environments Our sponsors Application Process The application process is designed to be clear and streamlined, yet responsive to the depth, potential, and specific needs of each project.Applications are now closed. A big thank you to everyone who applied! Information Handbook Step 1 - Online Application Submit your application via our online portal. The following documents will be required:CV & Credentials: including publications and awardsProject Proposal: including required infrastructure, budget calculation, and transfer optionsCertificates & letters of reference: e.g., degrees (PhD, Proof for 3 years research-experience in the AI-field) Step 2 - Pitch Selected applicants will be invited to present their project idea in a short pitch session in front of an interdisciplinary committee of experts from academia and industry. This step is about exploring the potential of your idea further and getting to know you as a researcher. Step 3 - Selection & Matching Based on your pitch and application, we will finalize the selection and begin aligning your residency with relevant partners, mentors, and infrastructure to help you hit the ground running. MEET OUR AMBASSADORS The IPAI Science Residency is supported by a group of esteemed ambassadors – internationally recognized AI-experts who believe in the program’s mission. Mina Saidze Tech Manager, AI Expert, and Author of FairTech Mina Saidze is a multiple award-winning Tech Manager, AI Expert, and Author. Manager Magazin refers to Mina as one of Germany's leading AI thought leaders. She founded Inclusive Tech, the first initiative in Europe for Diversity in Tech and AI ethics, and works in the field of Big Data and Artificial Intelligence. Mina was featured in Forbes Magazine's "30 under 30" list, named one of Capital Magazine's "Top 40 under 40," and designated as a LinkedIn Top Voice. The Financial Times and Oxford University named her among the "Women of the Future" in 2025. Her highly acclaimed book, "FairTech: Digitalisierung neu denken für eine gerechte Gesellschaft" (FairTech: Rethinking Digitalization for a Just Society), was published by Bastei Lübbe. Dr. Rebekka Reinhard Philosopher, Author, Founder and Editor-in Chief of „human“ Dr. Rebekka Reinhard is a philosopher, author and speaker. In 2023, she founded „human“, the first German magazine that holistically addresses the impact of AI on business, politics, society and culture to shape a future where technology serves people — and humanity defines progress. Dr. Anne Schreiter Executive Director GSO – Guidance, Skills & Opportunities for Researchers e. V. Dr. Anne Schreiter is the Executive Director of GSO* – Guidance, Skills & Opportunities for Researchers e.V., an independent nonprofit in Berlin that empowers researchers and institutions through career development and innovative funding programs. She holds a PhD in Organizational Sociology from the University of St. Gallen and conducted research at UC Berkeley. A certified systemic coach, Anne has designed leadership programs and facilitated numerous workshops helping researchers shape their careers within and beyond academia. She also serves on the advisory boards of the German Postdoc Network, Network Science Management, and the Kohli Foundation for Sociology. Connect with Our Team For any questions about the Science Residency – including research scope, eligibility, or collaboration opportunities – please don't hesitate to contact us.Joy LauterProject Leadscience-residency@ipai-foundation.ai *All consultation slots are currently booked. For questions, please contact science-residency@ipai-foundation.ai directly Our Partners FAQs These are the most commonly asked questions about the Science Residency. Can’t find what you’re looking for? Connect with Our Team Target group & funding areas Application Conditions Program procedure & content Perspectives Downloads Who can apply, and are there any restrictions regarding age, nationality, or professional background? Post-docs and researchers with at least three years of research experience with a focus on AI can apply. There is no age limit, and the program is open to applicants of all nationalities and disciplines—provided their research is related to artificial intelligence. What research areas are supported, and are interdisciplinary projects welcome? Yes—interdisciplinary work is strongly encouraged. Whether your background is in computer science, social sciences, biology, or law, the key is a clear connection to AI research and a commitment to bridging the gap between theory and real-world application. What is the application process, and which documents are required? The process begins with a written application, which should include your CV, a project description, relevant certificates, and letters of recommendation. If your application is successful, you’ll be invited to pitch your project to a panel of experts. Applications can be submitted in either English or German, but the project pitch must be presented in English. When is the application deadline, and can the application be updated afterward? The application phase opens on November 3, 2025 and closes on January 4, 2026. Once you submit your application, no further changes can be made. How can I contact the program team? You can get in touch directly with the program manager, Joy. She can be reached at: science-residency@ipai-foundation.ai How long does the residency last, and how many residents are selected annually? The residency initially runs for one year, with the possibility of a one-year extension. For the program launch in 2026, between 2 and 5 residents are expected to be selected. What is the funding amount, and what does it include? The residency is fully funded. In addition to a competitive salary, residents receive a self-managed project budget that can be used exclusively for project-related expenses—such as conference travel, software, or hardware. Is support offered for relocation, accommodation, and visa matters? The residency takes place in Heilbronn, Germany. Organizational support is provided for relocation and visa-related issues. Family-friendly planning is also taken into account. What mentoring and support opportunities are available duringthe residency? At the start of the program, each resident’s individual needs will be discussed and planned together. Depending on those needs, residents will have access to personalized mentoring, regular peer exchange formats, and targeted support in areas such as entrepreneurial thinking and science communication. What obligations do residents have during the program? Residents are expected to actively engage with the IPAI community and to publicly share the key outcomes of their research in a final publication. Additional results or outputs will be defined in alignment with each resident’s project proposal. Participation in workshops or lectures is not mandatory but is strongly encouraged. What career opportunities are there after the residency? After completing the residency, participants have the opportunity to join an alumni network. Alumni may go on to work in industry, launch their own ventures, or contribute to the broader community through open knowledge sharing and collaboration. Can the residency be postponed or ended early? The program is designed to support continuity and long-term engagement. However, flexible solutions can be arranged in justified exceptional cases, such as personal or professional circumstances that require a change in plans. Need more detailed information regarding the application process? The following PDF file has a even more details and instructions regarding the application process for the program. Download PDF.   • Analizzare e verificare telefonicamente o in teleassistenza le cause del problema segnalato dal cliente;

  • Gestire e monitorare eventuali tecnici esterni nel rispetto degli accordi commerciali presi;
  • Segnalare all’After Sales se a seguito di un intervento straordinario lo stato della macchina richiede una manutenzione generale su una o più parti con conseguente generazione di offerte;
  • Effettuare se necessario interventi on site.
Requisiti:
  • Diploma scuola superiore indirizzo tecnico -conoscenza lingua inglese -disponibilità a trasferte brevi (1-2gg/mese, spesso in giornata)
  • Pregressa esperienza nel ruolo di almeno 2 anni
  • Comprovata capacità di lettura e comprensione dello schema elettrico e conoscenza dei principali componenti elettrici;
  • Conoscenza di base del PLC in genere, con capacità di lettura di un programma finalizzato alla ricerca guasti
Orario di lavoro: full time 40 ore settimanali, da lunedì a venerdì con orario giornaliero o, in alternativa, turni 6-14 e 14-22. Richiesta disponibilità a straordinari. Prevista reperibilità telefonica Si offre inserimento diretto in azienda, retribuzione commisurata all'esperienza. El Regional Account Manager desarrollará relaciones comerciales con líderes de opinión hospitalarios y responsables de la toma de decisiones con el fin de maximizar el acceso a los productos de Alexion en las cuentas clave y hospitales identificados dentro de la región.

Será responsable de:

Principales Funciones

  • Proporcionar información científica y médica sobre los productos (NF1 – Koselugo, LAL-D – Kanuma) a líderes de opinión y responsables de la toma de decisiones.
  • Implementar la estrategia comercial de Alexion en las cuentas clave y hospitales asignados, asegurando el cumplimiento de los objetivos comerciales.
  • Identificar y comunicar a Alexion las necesidades, el entorno y los requisitos de las cuentas clave.
  • Construir una sólida red de relaciones de confianza con cuentas clave, hospitales, decisores e influenciadores.
  • Implementar planes educativos y de concienciación sobre enfermedades de acuerdo con las directrices y procedimientos establecidos, utilizando materiales y herramientas aprobadas.
  • Garantizar el acceso al tratamiento para todos los pacientes que sean candidatos adecuados.
  • Organizar reuniones formativas con el personal hospitalario, cuando sea necesario, con el apoyo del Departamento Médico.
  • Monitorizar y analizar datos y condiciones del mercado para identificar ventajas competitivas.
  • Mantener actualizado el sistema ETMS y realizar el correspondiente reporte y gestión de la relación con clientes (CRM).
  • Recoger y comunicar información de farmacovigilancia conforme a los procedimientos establecidos por el Departamento Médico.

Función de soporte

  • Compartir toda la información relevante con el equipo de Alexion Pharma en el país.
  • Colaborar de manera transversal con los equipos de Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access y Public Affairs.
  • Participar en la elaboración de la estrategia comercial y de marketing a nivel nacional.
  • Mantenerse informado sobre los cambios en las políticas sanitarias y evaluar su impacto en el negocio de Alexion.
  • Preparar e impartir presentaciones médicas, educativas y promocionales dirigidas a clientes y otros grupos de interés.

Cumplimiento

  • Garantizar que todas las actividades se desarrollen de acuerdo con la normativa farmacéutica vigente, así como con los valores, políticas y procedimientos internos de la compañía.

Requisitos:

  • Preferiblemente, al menos 5 años de experiencia en el entorno hospitalario, especialmente en enfermedades raras (deseable), medicamentos huérfanos, oncología o enfermedades complejas gestionadas de forma multidisciplinar.
  • Experiencia sólida en lanzamientos de productos, preferiblemente en entornos altamente competitivos donde haya sido necesario ganar cuota de mercado con rapidez.
  • Trayectoria de al menos 5 años gestionando cuentas hospitalarias multiespecialidad, con capacidad para interactuar eficazmente con distintos tipos de interlocutores (especialistas, farmacéuticos hospitalarios, gestores, dirección hospitalaria, etc.).
  • Se valorará experiencia o conocimientos en Neurología y Oncología.
  • Experiencia previa gestionando diferentes especialidades médicas dentro de una misma cuenta hospitalaria.
  • Experiencia en gestión de proyectos.
  • Historial demostrable de éxito comercial en posiciones hospitalarias especializadas.
  • Experiencia trabajando en entornos de alta complejidad científica, idealmente en enfermedades raras y/o oncología, desempeñando un rol comercial de campo con un alto grado de autonomía y capacidad de ejecución.
  • Capacidad para definir prioridades y gestionar eficazmente un territorio amplio y complejo, optimizando el tiempo y los recursos disponibles.
  • Capacidad para resolver problemas y gestionar situaciones complejas de manera eficaz.
  • Conocimiento de la normativa farmacéutica vigente en el país.
  • Nivel fluido de inglés, tanto oral como escrito.
  • Manejo de herramientas de Microsoft Office y sistemas de reporte.
  • Alta disponibilidad para viajar a nivel regional y nacional, especialmente debido a la gestión de un territorio que comprende Madrid, Castilla y León y Canarias, incluyendo desplazamientos con pernocta cuando sea necesario.
  • Experiencia trabajando en entornos altamente competitivos.
  • Zona de responsabilidad: Madrid, Castilla y León y Canarias.

Se valorará adicionalmente

  • Sólida base científica o médica.
  • Titulación universitaria en Ciencias de la Vida (preferiblemente) o en Administración de Empresas, Marketing o disciplinas afines.

content.Title: Mini-Job für ordnungsliebende Student*in: Haushalts / Putzhilfe in Bonn gesucht
content.MainContent: Startseite Stellenangebote Privatanzeige Mini-Job für ordnungsliebende Student*in: Haushalts / Putzhilfe Mini-Job für ordnungsliebende Student*in: Haushalts / Putzhilfe Anzeigen-Nr. 233100, veröffentlicht am 06.08.2026 Kategorie: Privatanzeige Dauer: 3 Stunden / 2x im Monat Beginn: Nach Absprache Vergütung: 20 EUR / Stunde Einsatzort: Bonn Kontakt­auf­nah­me: E-Mail Weiter zur Bewerbung Stellenbeschreibung Mini-Job für ordnungsliebende Student*in: Haushalts / PutzhilfeHallo an alle fleißigen Student*innen! Ich suche für meine 100 m² Maisonette-Wohnung (2 Etagen) eine zuverlässige, gründliche und absolut tierliebe Unterstützung.Da ich mir nach Jahren voller Power nun selbst mehr Entlastung im Alltag schenken möchte, suche ich dich als feste Hilfe in meinen 4 Wänden… Das Eckdaten-Paket: Wann: Jeden zweiten Dienstag von 08:30 Uhr bis 11:30 Uhr (das ist fix).Wo: Mainzer Straße in Bonn Mehlem. Parken ist hier super, einen sicheren Platz für ein Fahrrad gibt es auch.Vergütung: 20 € pro Stunde (60 € pro Einsatz), Zahlung direkt nach getaner Arbeit.Ablauf: Du brauchst keinen Schlüssel. Wir treffen uns um 08:30 Uhr, ich lasse dich rein und fahre dann in mein Büro.Dein kuscheliger Co-Chef: Mein absolut liebenswerter Dackel Luigi ist währenddessen im Schlafzimmer/Ankleidebereich (dieser Raum ist auch nicht in deinem Arbeitsbereich). Du solltest also ein absoluter Luigi-Fan sein und keine Angst vor Hunden haben! Er freut sich natürlich immer, wenn du ihm kurz „Hallo“ sagst. Deine Aufgaben (Klare To-Do-Liste):Die großen Bodenflächen musst du nicht machen - das übernimmt mein fleißiger Wisch-Saugroboter „Robert Rob“ alle 2 Tage. Dein Fokus liegt auf: Oberflächen: Staubwischen und feuchtes Reinigen aller freien Oberflächen.Die Treppe: Einmal fegen und feucht wischen.Die Bäder (Hauptfokus): Gründliche Reinigung des Dusch- & WannenbadesTerrasse: Einmal kurz abfegen und Oberflächen abwischen.Polster: Couch und Sessel gründlich absaugen. Die verbleibende Zeit nutzt du eigenständig mit einem „Blick für die Dinge“ wie zum Beispiel: ggf. Wäsche auf- oder abhängenggf. Spülmaschine ausräumenKühlschrank einmal auswischenKüchenschubladen nach Bedarf reinigenMüll beim Verlassen der Wohnung direkt mit runterbringen und neue Tüten einlegenFenster putzenUnd was Du sonst noch so siehst und Sinn macht Was du mitbringen solltest: Perfekte Deutschkenntnisse für eine reibungslose, klare Kommunikation.Wissen über Materialpflege: Du weißt genau, wie man mit Oberflächen umgeht, damit nichts verkratzt oder stumpf wird.Öko-Mindset: Ich arbeite ausschließlich mit hochwertigen, biologischen Putzmitteln (Zitronensäure, Natron, Öko-Universalreiniger). Ich stelle Dir alles bereit! Du solltest wissen, wie man diese umweltschonenden Mittel effektiv einsetzt.Auge fürs Detail: Du liebst es sauber, schlierenfrei und ordentlich.100% Vertrauen & Verlässlichkeit Der nächste Schritt:Klingt nach dem perfekten Nebenverdienst für dich? Dann schreib mir ein paar Zeilen über dich! Wenn die Chemie zwischen uns im Text stimmt, lernen wir uns ganz entspannt in einem 30-minütigen Zoom-Call kennen besprechen alles Weitere und klären deine Fragen. Ich freue mich auf dich!Ganz liebe Grüße, Julia & Luigi Zurück

content.MainContent: Job Helmholtz-Zentrum für Infektionsforschung, Abteilung Bioinformatik der Infektionsforschung (BRICS, Braunschweig) Das Helmholtz-Zentrum für Infektionsforschung mit Sitz in Braunschweig, betreibt als Mitglied der Helmholtz-Gemeinschaft Spitzenforschung auf dem Gebiet der Infektionskrankheiten. Unsere Wissenschaftler_innen entwickeln neuartige Methoden und Strategien, um Infektionskrankheiten immer schneller und wirksamer bekämpfen zu können. Unser gemeinsames Ziel sind neuartige Ansätze zu Prävention, Diagnose und Therapie von Infektionskrankheiten. Im Zentrum unserer Forschung bakterielle und virale Krankheitserreger, ihr Wechselspiel mit dem Immunsystem des Menschen und neue wirksame Wirkstoffe und Vakzine. Die Abteilung Bioinformatik der Infektionsforschung des Helmholtz Zentrums für Infektionsforschung unter der Leitung von Prof. Dr. Alice C. McHardy ist am Braunschweig Integrated Center for Systems Biology (BRICS) der Technischen Universität Braunschweig angesiedelt. Sie entwickelt und nutzt computergestützte Methoden, um das menschliche Mikrobiom, sowie virale und bakterielle Pathogene auf Basis umfangreicher biologischer und epidemiologischer Datensätze zu untersuchen. Dabei arbeitet die Abteilung eng mit nationalen und internationalen Forschungspartnern zusammen. Minijob zur Unterstützung der Abteilungsleitung Beschreibung des Jobs Für die Unterstützung unserer Abteilungsleitung, Prof. Dr. Alice C. McHardy, am Braunschweig Integrated Center for Systems Biology (BRICS) der Technischen Universität Braunschweig suchen wir eine engagierte Assistenz (m/w/d) auf Minijob-Basis. Diese Aufgaben erwarten Sie: Allgemeine Organisations-, Korrespondenz- und Koordinierungsarbeiten im Sekretariatsbereich Personal- und Budgetverwaltung inkl. Unterstützung in Projektmanagement (Monitoring von Arbeitsverträgen, administrative Planung von Investitionen) mit SAP Pflege von Webinhalten (BIFO-Webseite) Ihre Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten: Sehr gute deutsche Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Computerkenntnisse, insbesondere MS Office Selbständige, effiziente, genaue und gut organisierte Arbeitsweise Freundliche und hilfsbereite Persönlichkeit Belastbar, flexibel und teamfähig Vorteilhaft für diese Stelle:Englische Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind wünschenswert, nicht essentiell Wir bieten Ihnen: Eine attraktive und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem zukunftsorientierten Forschungsinstitut mit einem internationalen Eine hochmoderne Infrastruktur und modernste Technologien Flexible Arbeitszeitgestaltung, Teilzeitmodelle Eine Unternehmenskultur der Wertschätzung und Förderung der Chancengleichheit Umfangreiche Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zur Entwicklung fachlicher Kenntnisse und persönlicher Fähigkeiten Ein Familienbüro zur Unterstützung von Familie und Beruf, sowie Angebote für eine verbesserte Kinderbetreuung bspw. auch in den Ferien Interessante Zusatzleistungen des öffentlichen Dienstes Einstellungstermin: so schnell wie möglich, zunächst befristet auf sechs MonateArbeitszeit: 8-9h pro Woche (je nach Qualifikation)Arbeitsort: BRICS, Braunschweig Nähere Informationen erhalten Sie von Frau Carmen Paulmann, per E-Mail an: Carmen.Paulmann@helmholtz-hzi.de.Bitte fügen Sie Ihrer Bewerbung ein Anschreiben, einen Lebenslauf sowie relevante (Arbeits-)Zeugnisse und Zertifikate bei und senden Sie uns Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen zusammengefasst in einer PDF-Datei. Vergütung bis zu 603€ / Monat (Minijob) Kontaktdetails Bitte senden Sie Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen an Carmen.Paulmann@helmholtz-hzi.de

content.Title: Strategy
content.MainContent: Jobs im Bereich StrategyZu den JobsZukunft strategisch gestaltenDu denkst gerne voraus und möchtest die Zukunft eines Industrieunternehmens aktiv mitgestalten? Im Bereich Strategy analysierst du Märkte, entwickelst nachhaltige Konzepte und begleitest strategische Entscheidungen. Bei Aurubis arbeitest du an langfristigen Lösungen mit echter Wirkung.Offene Jobs42 / 42 jobs Clear all filtersKeine passende Stelle dabei?Wir freuen uns auch über Initiativbewerbungen – erzähl uns, wie du Aurubis mit deinen Fähigkeiten unterstützen möchtest.Zur InitiativbewerbungUnsere KernelementeWir arbeiten mit Metallen wie Gold, Silber und Kupfer. Doch unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter sind unser wertvollstes Element. Ohne sie gäbe es Aurubis nicht. Hier gibt jeder sein Bestes, jeden Tag. Das macht uns zu dem, was wir sind - ein starkes Unternehmen. Wir schaffen mit unseren Produkten die Basis für eine nachhaltige Gesellschaft: ob Energiewende, Digitalisierung oder Kreislaufwirtschaft. Unsere Kernelemente fassen unsere Stärken als einzigartigen Arbeitgeber zusammen und sie zeigen auch unseren Stolz für Aurubis.Rock-solid & RollingAurubis steht mit seinem soliden Geschäftsmodell für Stabilität als Arbeitgeber, auch in Krisenzeiten, entwickelt sich aber gleichzeitig jeden Tag weiter – mit dem Ziel, das effizienteste und nachhaltigste Hüttennetzwerk zu sein und Metalle für eine moderne Welt zu produzieren. Hands-on & High-techWeil wir an- und zupacken, mit unserer Leidenschaft für Metallurgie und mit inspirierenden Produktionsprozessen. Gleichzeitig entwickeln wir unsere Technologien und Prozesse ständig weiter, setzen neue Standards in unserer Industrie. Skilled & Seriously SustainableMehr als 7.000 qualifizierte Kolleginnen und Kollegen verwandeln hier täglich Rohstoffe verschiedenster Qualitäten auf nachhaltige Weise in wertvolle Produkte, die für die Gesellschaft, in der wir leben, einen deutlichen Unterschied machen.Was wir dir bietenMehr als fair bezahltBei uns profitierst du von einem attraktiven Gehalt auf Grundlage eines Tarifentgeltes der Chemie- bzw. Metallindustrie (abhängig vom Standort). Als Angestelle/r im Tarifbereich erhältst du zusätzliche Sonderzahlungen wie Urlaubsgeld und Jahresleistung. Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir dich mit einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und einer Erfolgsbeteiligung.Mobiles ArbeitenVereinbare dein Berufs- und Privatleben durch mobiles und flexibles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands. Du hast bei uns die Möglichkeit bis zu 3 Tage die Woche mobil zu arbeiten (abhängig von Position und Einsatzbereich).Work-Life-BalanceWork-Life-Balance ist uns genauso wichtig wie dir. Deshalb bieten wir dir moderne Arbeitszeitmodelle und flexible Arbeitszeiten, die zu deinem Leben passen. Bei uns sind (je nach Position und Einsatzbereich) Gleitzeit und Teilzeit möglich.30+ Tage UrlaubErholung ist uns wichtig! Bei uns bekommst du 30 Tage Urlaub und im Tarifbereich weitere Freistellungstage.Betriebliche GesundheitsförderungProfitiere von unserer betrieblichen Gesundheitsförderung. Wir haben einen Betriebsarzt auf dem Werksgelände und mit unseren Gesundheitsvorsorgeuntersuchungen, Impfungen und Physiotherapie-Angeboten sorgen wir dafür, dass du fit bleibst.Gesundheit in allen LebensphasenNutze unsere vertrauliche Online-Plattform mit wissenschaftlich fundierten Angeboten rund um Gesundheit, Familie, mentale Gesundheit und persönliche Lebensphasen. Videos, Kurse und Experten-Sessions stehen dir flexibel und anonym zur Verfügung.SportangeboteWir unterstützen deine Gesundheit und Fitness mit vielfältigen Sport- und Bewegungsangeboten, die dir Zugang zu zahlreichen Trainings- und Entspannungsmöglichkeiten bieten. Je nach Standort bezuschusst Aurubis eine Mitgliedschaft bei Hansefit oder Urban Sports Club.MobilitätsangeboteNutze gerne auch unser JobRad-Angebot, um die Mobilität nachhaltig zu verändern.WeiterbildungsangeboteWir begleiten und unterstützen dich bei deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung. Nutze unsere digitale Learning Academy und profitiere von vielfältigen Angeboten. Dein Bewerbungsprozess – schnell & einfachSchritt 1Online-Bewerbung:Bewirb dich in wenigen Minuten direkt über unsere Stellenanzeigen und lade deinen CV hoch.Schritt 2Unterlagen prüfen:Wir prüfen deine Unterlagen schnellstmöglich.
